1.zh: 耶和华的仆人摩西死了以后，耶和华晓谕摩西的帮手，嫩的儿子约书亚，说：
1.en: After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord , the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses' aide:

1.zh: 我的仆人摩西死了。现在你要起来，和众百姓过这约但河，往我所要赐给以色列人的地去。
1.en: "Moses my servant is dead. Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them-to the Israelites.

1.zh: 凡你们脚掌所踏之地，我都照著我所应许摩西的话赐给你们了。
1.en: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

1.zh: 从旷野和这利巴嫩，直到伯拉大河，赫人的全地，又到大海日落之处，都要作你们的境界。
1.en: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the great river, the Euphrates-all the Hittite country-to the Great Sea on the west.

1.zh: 你平生的日子，必无一人能在你面前站立得住。我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在；我必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。
1.en: No one will be able to stand up against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

1.zh: 你当刚强壮胆！因为你必使这百姓承受那地为业，就是我向他们列祖起誓应许赐给他们的地。
1.en: "Be strong and courageous, because you will lead these people to inherit the land I swore to their forefathers to give them.

1.zh: 只要刚强，大大壮胆，谨守遵行我仆人摩西所吩咐你的一切律法，不可偏离左右，使你无论往那里去，都可以顺利。
1.en: Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law my servant Moses gave you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go.

1.zh: 这律法书不可离开你的口，总要昼夜思想，好使你谨守遵行这书上所写的一切话。如此，你的道路就可以亨通，凡事顺利。
1.en: Do not let this Book of the Law depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.

1.zh: 我岂没有吩咐你么？你当刚强壮胆！不要惧怕，也不要惊惶；因为你无论往那里去，耶和华 ─ 你的神必与你同在。
1.en: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be terrified; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go."

1.zh: 于是，约书亚吩咐百姓的官长说：
1.en: So Joshua ordered the officers of the people:

1.zh: 你们要走遍营中，吩咐百姓说：当预备食物；因为三日之内你们要过这约但河，进去得耶和华 ─ 你们神赐你们为业之地。
1.en: "Go through the camp and tell the people, 'Get your supplies ready. Three days from now you will cross the Jordan here to go in and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you for your own.' "

1.zh: 约书亚对流便人 、 迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人说：
1.en: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,

1.zh: 你们要追念耶和华的仆人摩西所吩咐你们的话说：耶和华 ─ 你们的神使你们得享平安，也必将这地赐给你们。
1.en: "Remember the command that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you: 'The Lord your God is giving you rest and has granted you this land.'

1.zh: 你们的妻子 、 孩子，和牲畜都可以留在约但河东 、 摩西所给你们的地；但你们中间一切大能的勇士都要带著兵器在你们的弟兄前面过去，帮助他们，
1.en: Your wives, your children and your livestock may stay in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan, but all your fighting men, fully armed, must cross over ahead of your brothers. You are to help your brothers

1.zh: 等到耶和华使你们的弟兄像你们一样得享平安，并且得著耶和华 ─ 你们神所赐他们为业之地，那时才可以回你们所得之地，承受为业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约但河东 、 向日出之地所给你们的。
1.en: until the Lord gives them rest, as he has done for you, and until they too have taken possession of the land that the Lord your God is giving them. After that, you may go back and occupy your own land, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you east of the Jordan toward the sunrise."

1.zh: 他们回答约书亚说：你所吩咐我们行的，我们都必行；你所差遣我们去的，我们都必去。
1.en: Then they answered Joshua, "Whatever you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

1.zh: 我们从前在一切事上怎样听从摩西，现在也必照样听从你；惟愿耶和华 ─ 你的神与你同在，像与摩西同在一样。
1.en: Just as we fully obeyed Moses, so we will obey you. Only may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses.

1.zh: 无论甚么人违背你的命令，不听从你所吩咐他的一切话，就必治死他。你只要刚强壮胆！
1.en: Whoever rebels against your word and does not obey your words, whatever you may command them, will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!"

2.zh: 当下，嫩的儿子约书亚从什亭暗暗打发两个人作探子，吩咐说：你们去窥探那地和耶利哥。于是二人去了，来到一个妓女名叫喇合的家里，就在那里躺卧。
2.en: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim. "Go, look over the land," he said, "especially Jericho." So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.

2.zh: 有人告诉耶利哥王说：今夜有以色列人来到这里窥探此地。
2.en: The king of Jericho was told, "Look! Some of the Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land."

2.zh: 耶利哥王打发人去见喇合说：那来到你这里 、 进了你家的人要交出来，因为他们来窥探全地。
2.en: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: "Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, because they have come to spy out the whole land."

2.zh: 女人将二人隐藏，就回答说：那人果然到我这里来；他们是那里来的我却不知道。
2.en: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, "Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they had come from.

2.zh: 天黑 、 要关城门的时候，他们出去了，往那里去我却不知道。你们快快的去追赶，就必追上。
2.en: At dusk, when it was time to close the city gate, the men left. I don't know which way they went. Go after them quickly. You may catch up with them."

2.zh: （先是女人领二人上了房顶，将他们藏在那里所摆的麻中。）
2.en: (But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the stalks of flax she had laid out on the roof.)

2.zh: 那些人就往约但河的渡口追赶他们去了。追赶他们的人一出去，城门就关了。
2.en: So the men set out in pursuit of the spies on the road that leads to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.

2.zh: 二人还没有躺卧，女人就上房顶，到他们那里，
2.en: Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up on the roof

2.zh: 对他们说：我知道耶和华已经把这地赐给你们，并且因你们的缘故我们都惊慌了。这地的一切居民在你们面前心都消化了；
2.en: and said to them, "I know that the Lord has given this land to you and that a great fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who live in this country are melting in fear because of you.

2.zh: 因为我们听见你们出埃及的时候，耶和华怎样在你们前面使红海的水干了，并且你们怎样待约但河东的两个亚摩利王西宏和噩，将他们尽行毁灭。
2.en: We have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan, whom you completely destroyed.

2.zh: 我们一听见这些事，心就消化了。因你们的缘故，并无一人有胆气。耶和华 ─ 你们的神本是上天下地的神。
2.en: When we heard of it, our hearts melted and everyone's courage failed because of you, for the Lord your God is God in heaven above and on the earth below.

2.zh: 现在我既是恩待你们，求你们指著耶和华向我起誓，也要恩待我父家，并给我一个实在的证据，
2.en: Now then, please swear to me by the Lord that you will show kindness to my family, because I have shown kindness to you. Give me a sure sign

2.zh: 要救活我的父母 、 弟兄 、 姊妹，和一切属他们的，拯救我们性命不死。
2.en: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and that you will save us from death."

2.zh: 二人对他说：你若不泄漏我们这件事，我们情愿替你们死。耶和华将这地赐给我们的时候，我们必以慈爱诚实待你。
2.en: "Our lives for your lives!" the men assured her. "If you don't tell what we are doing, we will treat you kindly and faithfully when the Lord gives us the land."

2.zh: 于是女人用绳子将二人从窗户里缒下去；因他的房子是在城墙边上，他也住在城墙上。
2.en: So she let them down by a rope through the window, for the house she lived in was part of the city wall.

2.zh: 他对他们说：你们且往山上去，恐怕追赶的人碰见你们；要在那里隐藏三天，等追赶的人回来，然后才可以走你们的路。
2.en: Now she had said to them, "Go to the hills so the pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there three days until they return, and then go on your way."

2.zh: 二人对他说：你要这样行。不然，你叫我们所起的誓就与我们无干了。
2.en: The men said to her, "This oath you made us swear will not be binding on us

2.zh: 我们来到这地的时候，你要把这条朱红线绳系在缒我们下去的窗户上，并要使你的父母 、 弟兄，和你父的全家都聚集在你家中。
2.en: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother, your brothers and all your family into your house.

2.zh: 凡出了你家门往街上去的，他的罪（原文是血）必归到自己的头上，与我们无干了。凡在你家里的，若有人下手害他，流他血的罪就归到我们的头上。
2.en: If anyone goes outside your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head; we will not be responsible. As for anyone who is in the house with you, his blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on him.

2.zh: 你若泄漏我们这件事，你叫我们所起的誓就与我们无干了。
2.en: But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear."

2.zh: 女人说：照你们的话行罢！于是打发他们去了，又把朱红线绳系在窗户上。
2.en: "Agreed," she replied. "Let it be as you say." So she sent them away and they departed. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

2.zh: 二人到山上，在那里住了三天，等著追赶的人回去了。追赶的人一路找他们，却找不著。
2.en: When they left, they went into the hills and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had searched all along the road and returned without finding them.

2.zh: 二人就下山回来，过了河，到嫩的儿子约书亚那里，向他述说所遭遇的一切事；
2.en: Then the two men started back. They went down out of the hills, forded the river and came to Joshua son of Nun and told him everything that had happened to them.

2.zh: 又对约书亚说：耶和华果然将那全地交在我们手中；那地的一切居民在我们面前心都消化了。
2.en: They said to Joshua, "The Lord has surely given the whole land into our hands; all the people are melting in fear because of us."

3.zh: 约书亚清早起来，和以色列众人都离开什亭，来到约但河，就住在那里，等候过河。
3.en: Early in the morning Joshua and all the Israelites set out from Shittim and went to the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.

3.zh: 过了三天，官长走遍营中，
3.en: After three days the officers went throughout the camp,

3.zh: 吩咐百姓说：你们看见耶和华 ─ 你们神的约柜，又见祭司利未人抬著，就要离开所住的地方，跟著约柜去。
3.en: giving orders to the people: "When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the priests, who are Levites, carrying it, you are to move out from your positions and follow it.

3.zh: 只是你们和约柜相离要量二千肘，不可与约柜相近，使你们知道所当走的路，因为这条路你们向来没有走过。
3.en: Then you will know which way to go, since you have never been this way before. But keep a distance of about a thousand yards between you and the ark; do not go near it."

3.zh: 约书亚吩咐百姓说：你们要自洁，因为明天耶和华必在你们中间行奇事。
3.en: Joshua told the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you."

3.zh: 约书亚又吩咐祭司说：你们抬起约柜，在百姓前头过去。于是他们抬起约柜，在百姓前头走。
3.en: Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on ahead of the people." So they took it up and went ahead of them.

3.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：从今日起，我必使你在以色列众人眼前尊大，使他们知道我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在。
3.en: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I will begin to exalt you in the eyes of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you as I was with Moses.

3.zh: 你要吩咐抬约柜的祭司说：你们到了约但河的水边上，就要在约但河水里站住。
3.en: Tell the priests who carry the ark of the covenant: 'When you reach the edge of the Jordan's waters, go and stand in the river.' "

3.zh: 约书亚对以色列人说：你们近前来，听耶和华 ─ 你们神的话。
3.en: Joshua said to the Israelites, "Come here and listen to the words of the Lord your God.

3.zh: 约书亚说：看哪，普天下主的约柜必在你们前头过去，到约但河里，因此你们就知道在你们中间有永生神；并且他必在你们面前赶出迦南人 、 赫人 、 希未人 、 比利洗人 、 革迦撒人 、 亚摩利人 、 耶布斯人。
3.en: This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that he will certainly drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites.
See, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go into the Jordan ahead of you.

3.zh: 你们现在要从以色列支派中拣选十二个人，每支派一人，
3.en: Now then, choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.

3.zh: 等到抬普天下主耶和华约柜的祭司把脚站在约但河水里，约但河的水，就是从上往下流的水，必然断绝，立起成垒。
3.en: And as soon as the priests who carry the ark of the Lord -the Lord of all the earth-set foot in the Jordan, its waters flowing downstream will be cut off and stand up in a heap."

3.zh: 百姓离开帐棚要过约但河的时候，抬约柜的祭司乃在百姓的前头。
3.en: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carrying the ark of the covenant went ahead of them.

3.zh: 他们到了约但河，脚一入水（原来约但河水在收割的日子涨过两岸），
3.en: Now the Jordan is at flood stage all during harvest. Yet as soon as the priests who carried the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water's edge,

3.zh: 那从上往下流的水便在极远之地 、 撒拉但旁的亚当城那里停住，立起成垒；那往亚拉巴的海，就是盐海，下流的水全然断绝。于是百姓在耶利哥的对面过去了。
3.en: the water from upstream stopped flowing. It piled up in a heap a great distance away, at a town called Adam in the vicinity of Zarethan, while the water flowing down to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ) was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.

3.zh: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司在约但河中的干地上站定，以色列众人都从干地上过去，直到国民尽都过了约但河。
3.en: The priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, while all Israel passed by until the whole nation had completed the crossing on dry ground.

4.zh: 国民尽都过了约但河，耶和华就对约书亚说：
4.en: When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua,

4.zh: 你从民中要拣选十二个人，每支派一人，
4.en: "Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe,

4.zh: 吩咐他们说：你们从这里，从约但河中 、 祭司脚站定的地方，取十二块石头带过去，放在你们今夜要住宿的地方。
4.en: and tell them to take up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan from right where the priests stood and to carry them over with you and put them down at the place where you stay tonight."

4.zh: 于是，约书亚将他从以色列人中所预备的那十二个人，每支派一人，都召了来。
4.en: So Joshua called together the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe,

4.zh: 对他们说：你们下约但河中，过到耶和华 ─ 你们神的约柜前头，按著以色列人十二支派的数目，每人取一块石头扛在肩上。
4.en: and said to them, "Go over before the ark of the Lord your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take up a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites,

4.zh: 这些石头在你们中间可以作为证据。日后，你们的子孙问你们说：这些石头是甚么意思？
4.en: to serve as a sign among you. In the future, when your children ask you, 'What do these stones mean?'

4.zh: 你们就对他们说：这是因为约但河的水在耶和华的约柜前断绝；约柜过约但河的时候，约但河的水就断绝了。这些石头要作以色列人永远的纪念。
4.en: tell them that the flow of the Jordan was cut off before the ark of the covenant of the Lord . When it crossed the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones are to be a memorial to the people of Israel forever."

4.zh: 以色列人就照约书亚所吩咐的，按著以色列人支派的数目，从约但河中取了十二块石头，都遵耶和华所吩咐约书亚的行了。他们把石头带过去，到他们所住宿的地方，就放在那里。
4.en: So the Israelites did as Joshua commanded them. They took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites, as the Lord had told Joshua; and they carried them over with them to their camp, where they put them down.

4.zh: 约书亚另把十二块石头立在约但河中，在抬约柜的祭司脚站立的地方；直到今日，那石头还在那里。
4.en: Joshua set up the twelve stones that had been in the middle of the Jordan at the spot where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant had stood. And they are there to this day.

4.zh: 抬约柜的祭司站在约但河中，等到耶和华晓谕约书亚吩咐百姓的事办完了，是照摩西所吩咐约书亚的一切话。于是百姓急速过去了。
4.en: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything the Lord had commanded Joshua was done by the people, just as Moses had directed Joshua. The people hurried over,

4.zh: 众百姓尽都过了河，耶和华的约柜和祭司就在百姓面前过去。
4.en: and as soon as all of them had crossed, the ark of the Lord and the priests came to the other side while the people watched.

4.zh: 流便人 、 迦得人 、 玛拿西半支派的人都照摩西所吩咐他们的，带著兵器在以色列人前头过去。
4.en: The men of Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over, armed, in front of the Israelites, as Moses had directed them.

4.zh: 约有四万人都准备打仗，在耶和华面前过去，到耶利哥的平原，等候上阵。
4.en: About forty thousand armed for battle crossed over before the Lord to the plains of Jericho for war.

4.zh: 当那日，耶和华使约书亚在以色列众人眼前尊大。在他平生的日子，百姓敬畏他，像从前敬畏摩西一样。
4.en: That day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they revered him all the days of his life, just as they had revered Moses.

4.zh: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说：
4.en: Then the Lord said to Joshua,

4.zh: 你吩咐抬法柜的祭司从约但河里上来。
4.en: "Command the priests carrying the ark of the Testimony to come up out of the Jordan."

4.zh: 约书亚就吩咐祭司说：你们从约但河里上来。
4.en: So Joshua commanded the priests, "Come up out of the Jordan."

4.zh: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司从约但河里上来，脚掌刚落旱地，约但河的水就流到原处，仍旧涨过两岸。
4.en: And the priests came up out of the river carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord . No sooner had they set their feet on the dry ground than the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and ran at flood stage as before.

4.zh: 正月初十日，百姓从约但河里上来，就在吉甲，在耶利哥的东边安营。
4.en: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.

4.zh: 他们从约但河中取来的那十二块石头，约书亚就立在吉甲，
4.en: And Joshua set up at Gilgal the twelve stones they had taken out of the Jordan.

4.zh: 对以色列人说：日后你们的子孙问他们的父亲说：这些石头是甚么意思？
4.en: He said to the Israelites, "In the future when your descendants ask their fathers, 'What do these stones mean?'

4.zh: 你们就告诉他们说：以色列人曾走干地过这约但河；
4.en: tell them, 'Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.'

4.zh: 因为耶和华 ─ 你们的神在你们前面使约但河的水干了，等著你们过来，就如耶和华 ─ 你们的神从前在我们前面使红海干了，等著我们过来一样，
4.en: For the Lord your God dried up the Jordan before you until you had crossed over. The Lord your God did to the Jordan just what he had done to the Red Sea when he dried it up before us until we had crossed over.

4.zh: 要使地上万民都知道，耶和华的手大有能力，也要使你们永远敬畏耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
4.en: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the Lord is powerful and so that you might always fear the Lord your God."

5.zh: 约但河西亚摩利人的诸王和靠海迦南人的诸王，听见耶和华在以色列人前面使约但河的水干了，等到我们过去，他们的心因以色列人的缘故就消化了，不再有胆气。
5.en: Now when all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings along the coast heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan before the Israelites until we had crossed over, their hearts melted and they no longer had the courage to face the Israelites.

5.zh: 那时，耶和华吩咐约书亚说：你制造火石刀，第二次给以色列人行割礼。
5.en: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelites again."

5.zh: 约书亚就制造了火石刀，在除皮山那里给以色列人行割礼。
5.en: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the Israelites at Gibeath Haaraloth.

5.zh: 约书亚行割礼的缘故，是因为从埃及出来的众民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以后，都死在旷野的路上。
5.en: Now this is why he did so: All those who came out of Egypt-all the men of military age-died in the desert on the way after leaving Egypt.

5.zh: 因为出来的众民都受过割礼；惟独出埃及以后 、 在旷野的路上所生的众民都没有受过割礼。
5.en: All the people that came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the desert during the journey from Egypt had not.

5.zh: 以色列人在旷野走了四十年，等到国民，就是出埃及的兵丁，都消灭了，因为他们没有听从耶和华的话。耶和华曾向他们起誓，必不容他们看见耶和华向他们列祖起誓 、 应许赐给我们的地，就是流奶与蜜之地。
5.en: The Israelites had moved about in the desert forty years until all the men who were of military age when they left Egypt had died, since they had not obeyed the Lord . For the Lord had sworn to them that they would not see the land that he had solemnly promised their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

5.zh: 他们的子孙，就是耶和华所兴起来接续他们的，都没有受过割礼；因为在路上没有给他们行割礼，约书亚这才给他们行了。
5.en: So he raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones Joshua circumcised. They were still uncircumcised because they had not been circumcised on the way.

5.zh: 国民都受完了割礼，就住在营中自己的地方，等到痊愈了。
5.en: And after the whole nation had been circumcised, they remained where they were in camp until they were healed.

5.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：我今日将埃及的羞辱从你们身上辊去了。因此，那地方名叫吉甲（吉甲就是辊的意思），直到今日。
5.en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you." So the place has been called Gilgal to this day.

5.zh: 以色列人在吉甲安营。正月十四日晚上，在耶利哥的平原守逾越节。
5.en: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, the Israelites celebrated the Passover.

5.zh: 逾越节的次日，他们就吃了那地的出产；正当那日吃无酵饼和烘的谷。
5.en: The day after the Passover, that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.

5.zh: 他们吃了那地的出产，第二日吗哪就止住了，以色列人也不再有吗哪了。那一年，他们却吃迦南地的出产。
5.en: The manna stopped the day after they ate this food from the land; there was no longer any manna for the Israelites, but that year they ate of the produce of Canaan.

5.zh: 约书亚靠近耶利哥的时候，举目观看，不料，有一个人手里有拔出来的刀，对面站立。约书亚到他那里，问他说：你是帮助我们呢，是帮助我们敌人呢？
5.en: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with a drawn sword in his hand. Joshua went up to him and asked, "Are you for us or for our enemies?"

5.zh: 他回答说：不是的，我来是要作耶和华军队的元帅。约书亚就俯伏在地下拜，说：我主有甚么话吩咐仆人。
5.en: "Neither," he replied, "but as commander of the army of the Lord I have now come." Then Joshua fell facedown to the ground in reverence, and asked him, "What message does my Lord have for his servant?"

5.zh: 耶和华军队的元帅对约书亚说：把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站的地方是圣的。约书亚就照著行了。
5.en: The commander of the Lord 's army replied, "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy." And Joshua did so.

6.zh: 耶利哥的城门因以色列人就关得严紧，无人出入。
6.en: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说：看哪，我已经把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，并大能的勇士，都交在你手中。
6.en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "See, I have delivered Jericho into your hands, along with its king and its fighting men.

6.zh: 你们的一切兵丁要围绕这城，一日围绕一次，六日都要这样行。
6.en: March around the city once with all the armed men. Do this for six days.

6.zh: 七个祭司要拿七个羊角走在约柜前。到第七日，你们要绕城七次，祭司也要吹角。
6.en: Have seven priests carry trumpets of rams' horns in front of the ark. On the seventh day, march around the city seven times, with the priests blowing the trumpets.

6.zh: 他们吹的角声拖长，你们听见角声，众百姓要大声呼喊，城墙就必塌陷，各人都要往前直上。
6.en: When you hear them sound a long blast on the trumpets, have all the people give a loud shout; then the wall of the city will collapse and the people will go up, every man straight in."

6.zh: 嫩的儿子约书亚召了祭司来，吩咐他们说：你们抬起约柜来，要有七个祭司拿七个羊角走在耶和华的约柜前；
6.en: So Joshua son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and have seven priests carry trumpets in front of it."

6.zh: 又对百姓说：你们前去绕城，带兵器的要走在耶和华的约柜前。
6.en: And he ordered the people, "Advance! March around the city, with the armed guard going ahead of the ark of the Lord ."

6.zh: 约书亚对百姓说完了话，七个祭司拿七个羊角走在耶和华面前吹角；耶和华的约柜在他们后面跟随。
6.en: When Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets before the Lord went forward, blowing their trumpets, and the ark of the Lord 's covenant followed them.

6.zh: 带兵器的走在吹角的祭司前面，后队随著约柜行。祭司一面走一面吹。
6.en: The armed guard marched ahead of the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard followed the ark. All this time the trumpets were sounding.

6.zh: 约书亚吩咐百姓说：你们不可呼喊，不可出声，连一句话也不可出你们的口，等到我吩咐你们呼喊的日子，那时才可以呼喊。
6.en: But Joshua had commanded the people, "Do not give a war cry, do not raise your voices, do not say a word until the day I tell you to shout. Then shout!"

6.zh: 这样，他使耶和华的约柜绕城，把城绕了一次；众人回到营里，就在营里住宿。
6.en: So he had the ark of the Lord carried around the city, circling it once. Then the people returned to camp and spent the night there.

6.zh: 约书亚清早起来，祭司又抬起耶和华的约柜。
6.en: Joshua got up early the next morning and the priests took up the ark of the Lord .

6.zh: 七个祭司拿七个羊角在耶和华的约柜前，时常行走吹角；带兵器的在他们前面走，后队随著耶和华的约柜行。祭司一面走一面吹。
6.en: The seven priests carrying the seven trumpets went forward, marching before the ark of the Lord and blowing the trumpets. The armed men went ahead of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the Lord , while the trumpets kept sounding.

6.zh: 第二日，众人把城绕了一次，就回营里去。六日都是这样行。
6.en: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.

6.zh: 第七日清早，黎明的时候，他们起来，照样绕城七次；惟独这日把城绕了七次。
6.en: On the seventh day, they got up at daybreak and marched around the city seven times in the same manner, except that on that day they circled the city seven times.

6.zh: 到了第七次，祭司吹角的时候，约书亚吩咐百姓说：呼喊罢，因为耶和华已经把城交给你们了！
6.en: The seventh time around, when the priests sounded the trumpet blast, Joshua commanded the people, "Shout! For the Lord has given you the city!

6.zh: 这城和其中所有的都要在耶和华面前毁灭；只有妓女喇合与他家中所有的可以存活，因为他隐藏了我们所打发的使者。
6.en: The city and all that is in it are to be devoted to the Lord . Only Rahab the prostitute and all who are with her in her house shall be spared, because she hid the spies we sent.

6.zh: 至于你们，务要谨慎，不可取那当灭的物，恐怕你们取了那当灭的物就连累以色列的全营，使全营受咒诅。
6.en: But keep away from the devoted things, so that you will not bring about your own destruction by taking any of them. Otherwise you will make the camp of Israel liable to destruction and bring trouble on it.

6.zh: 惟有金子 、 银子，和铜铁的器皿都要归耶和华为圣，必入耶和华的库中。
6.en: All the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron are sacred to the Lord and must go into his treasury."

6.zh: 于是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹角。百姓听见角声，便大声呼喊，城墙就塌陷，百姓便上去进城，各人往前直上，将城夺取。
6.en: When the trumpets sounded, the people shouted, and at the sound of the trumpet, when the people gave a loud shout, the wall collapsed; so every man charged straight in, and they took the city.

6.zh: 又将城中所有的，不拘男女老少，牛羊和驴，都用刀杀尽。
6.en: They devoted the city to the Lord and destroyed with the sword every living thing in it-men and women, young and old, cattle, sheep and donkeys.

6.zh: 约书亚吩咐窥探地的两个人说：你们进那妓女的家，照著你们向他所起的誓，将那女人和他所有的都从那里带出来。
6.en: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, "Go into the prostitute's house and bring her out and all who belong to her, in accordance with your oath to her."

6.zh: 当探子的两个少年人就进去，将喇合与他的父母 、 弟兄，和他所有的，并他一切的亲眷，都带出来，安置在以色列的营外。
6.en: So the young men who had done the spying went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother and brothers and all who belonged to her. They brought out her entire family and put them in a place outside the camp of Israel.

6.zh: 众人就用火将城和其中所有的焚烧了；惟有金子 、 银子，和铜铁的器皿都放在耶和华殿的库中。
6.en: Then they burned the whole city and everything in it, but they put the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the Lord 's house.

6.zh: 约书亚却把妓女喇合与他父家，并他所有的，都救活了；因为他隐藏了约书亚所打发窥探耶利哥的使者，他就住在以色列中，直到今日。
6.en: But Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her family and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent as spies to Jericho-and she lives among the Israelites to this day.

6.zh: 当时，约书亚叫众人起誓说：有兴起重修这耶利哥城的人，当在耶和华面前受咒诅。他立根基的时候，必丧长子，安门的时候，必丧幼子。
6.en: At that time Joshua pronounced this solemn oath: "Cursed before the Lord is the man who undertakes to rebuild this city, Jericho: "At the cost of his firstborn son will he lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest will he set up its gates."

6.zh: 耶和华与约书亚同在，约书亚的声名传扬遍地。
6.en: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.

7.zh: 以色列人在当灭的物上犯了罪；因为犹大支派中，谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干取了当灭的物；耶和华的怒气就向以色列人发作。
7.en: But the Israelites acted unfaithfully in regard to the devoted things ; Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of them. So the Lord 's anger burned against Israel.

7.zh: 当下，约书亚从耶利哥打发人往伯特利东边 、 靠近伯亚文的艾城去，吩咐他们说：你们上去窥探那地。他们就上去窥探艾城。
7.en: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth Aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, "Go up and spy out the region." So the men went up and spied out Ai.

7.zh: 他们回到约书亚那里，对他说：众民不必都上去，只要二三千人上去就能攻取艾城；不必劳累众民都去，因为那里的人少。
7.en: When they returned to Joshua, they said, "Not all the people will have to go up against Ai. Send two or three thousand men to take it and do not weary all the people, for only a few men are there."

7.zh: 于是民中约有三千人上那里去，竟在艾城人面前逃跑了。
7.en: So about three thousand men went up; but they were routed by the men of Ai,

7.zh: 艾城的人击杀了他们三十六人，从城门前追赶他们，直到示巴琳，在下坡杀败他们；众民的心就消化如水。
7.en: who killed about thirty-six of them. They chased the Israelites from the city gate as far as the stone quarries and struck them down on the slopes. At this the hearts of the people melted and became like water.

7.zh: 约书亚便撕裂衣服；他和以色列的长老把灰撒在头上，在耶和华的约柜前俯伏在地，直到晚上。
7.en: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown to the ground before the ark of the Lord , remaining there till evening. The elders of Israel did the same, and sprinkled dust on their heads.

7.zh: 约书亚说：哀哉！主耶和华阿，你为甚么竟领这百姓过约但河，将我们交在亚摩利人的手中，使我们灭亡呢？我们不如住在约但河那边倒好。
7.en: And Joshua said, "Ah, Sovereign Lord , why did you ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!

7.zh: 主阿，以色列人既在仇敌面前转背逃跑，我还有甚么可说的呢？
7.en: O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has been routed by its enemies?

7.zh: 迦南人和这地一切的居民听见了就必围困我们，将我们的名从地上除灭。那时你为你的大名要怎样行呢？
7.en: The Canaanites and the other people of the country will hear about this and they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. What then will you do for your own great name?"

7.zh: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说：起来！你为何这样俯伏在地呢？
7.en: The Lord said to Joshua, "Stand up! What are you doing down on your face?

7.zh: 以色列人犯了罪，违背了我所吩咐他们的约，取了当灭的物；又偷窃，又行诡诈，又把那当灭的放在他们的家具里。
7.en: Israel has sinned; they have violated my covenant, which I commanded them to keep. They have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen, they have lied, they have put them with their own possessions.

7.zh: 因此，以色列人在仇敌面前站立不住。他们在仇敌面前转背逃跑，是因成了被咒诅的；你们若不把当灭的物从你们中间除掉，我就不再与你们同在了。
7.en: That is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies; they turn their backs and run because they have been made liable to destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you destroy whatever among you is devoted to destruction.

7.zh: 你起来，叫百姓自洁，对他们说：你们要自洁，预备明天，因为耶和华 ─ 以色列的神这样说：以色列阿，你们中间有当灭的物，你们若不除掉，在仇敌面前必站立不住！
7.en: "Go, consecrate the people. Tell them, 'Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow; for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: That which is devoted is among you, O Israel. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove it.

7.zh: 到了早晨，你们要按著支派近前来；耶和华所取的支派，要按著宗族近前来；耶和华所取的宗族，要按著家室近前来；耶和华所取的家室，要按著人丁，一个一个的近前来。
7.en: " 'In the morning, present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe that the Lord takes shall come forward clan by clan; the clan that the Lord takes shall come forward family by family; and the family that the Lord takes shall come forward man by man.

7.zh: 被取的人有当灭的物在他那里，他和他所有的必被火焚烧；因他违背了耶和华的约，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。
7.en: He who is caught with the devoted things shall be destroyed by fire, along with all that belongs to him. He has violated the covenant of the Lord and has done a disgraceful thing in Israel!' "

7.zh: 于是，约书亚清早起来，使以色列人按著支派近前来，取出来的是犹大支派；
7.en: Early the next morning Joshua had Israel come forward by tribes, and Judah was taken.

7.zh: 使犹大支派（原文是宗族）近前来，就取了谢拉的宗族；使谢拉的宗族，按著家室人丁，一个一个的近前来，取出来的是撒底；
7.en: The clans of Judah came forward, and he took the Zerahites. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward by families, and Zimri was taken.

7.zh: 使撒底的家室，按著人丁，一个一个的近前来，就取出犹大支派的人谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干。
7.en: Joshua had his family come forward man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

7.zh: 约书亚对亚干说：我儿，我劝你将荣耀归给耶和华 ─ 以色列的神，在他面前认罪，将你所做的事告诉我，不要向我隐瞒。
7.en: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, give glory to the Lord , the God of Israel, and give him the praise. Tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me."

7.zh: 亚干回答约书亚说：我实在得罪了耶和华 ─ 以色列的神。我所做的事如此如此：
7.en: Achan replied, "It is true! I have sinned against the Lord , the God of Israel. This is what I have done:

7.zh: 我在所夺的财物中看见一件美好的示拿衣服，二百舍客勒银子，一条金子重五十舍客勒，我就贪爱这些物件，便拿去了。现今藏在我帐棚内的地里，银子在衣服底下。
7.en: When I saw in the plunder a beautiful robe from Babylonia, two hundred shekels of silver and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath."

7.zh: 约书亚就打发人跑到亚干的帐棚里。那件衣服果然藏在他帐棚内，银子在底下。
7.en: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent, and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.

7.zh: 他们就从帐棚里取出来，拿到约书亚和以色列众人那里，放在耶和华面前。
7.en: They took the things from the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites and spread them out before the Lord .

7.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人把谢拉的曾孙亚干和那银子 、 那件衣服 、 那条金子，并亚干的儿女 、 牛 、 驴 、 羊 、 帐棚，以及他所有的，都带到亚割谷去。
7.en: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the gold wedge, his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys and sheep, his tent and all that he had, to the Valley of Achor.

7.zh: 约书亚说：你为甚么连累我们呢？今日耶和华必叫你受连累。于是以色列众人用石头打死他，将石头扔在其上，又用火焚烧他所有的（他所有的原文作他们）。
7.en: Joshua said, "Why have you brought this trouble on us? The Lord will bring trouble on you today." Then all Israel stoned him, and after they had stoned the rest, they burned them.

7.zh: 众人在亚干身上堆成一大堆石头，直存到今日。于是耶和华转意，不发他的烈怒。因此那地方名叫亚割谷（亚割就是连累的意思），直到今日。
7.en: Over Achan they heaped up a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day. Then the Lord turned from his fierce anger. Therefore that place has been called the Valley of Achor ever since.

8.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。你起来，率领一切兵丁上艾城去，我已经把艾城的王和他的民 、 他的城，并他的地，都交在你手里。
8.en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. For I have delivered into your hands the king of Ai, his people, his city and his land.

8.zh: 你怎样待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也当照样待艾城和艾城的王。只是城内所夺的财物和牲畜，你们可以取为自己的掠物。你要在城后设下伏兵。
8.en: You shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush behind the city."

8.zh: 于是，约书亚和一切兵丁都起来，要上艾城去。约书亚选了三万大能的勇士，夜间打发他们前往，
8.en: So Joshua and the whole army moved out to attack Ai. He chose thirty thousand of his best fighting men and sent them out at night

8.zh: 吩咐他们说：你们要在城后埋伏，不可离城太远，都要各自准备。
8.en: with these orders: "Listen carefully. You are to set an ambush behind the city. Don't go very far from it. All of you be on the alert.

8.zh: 我与我所带领的众民要向城前往。城里的人像初次出来攻击我们的时候，我们就在他们面前逃跑，
8.en: I and all those with me will advance on the city, and when the men come out against us, as they did before, we will flee from them.

8.zh: 他们必出来追赶我们，直到我们引诱他们离开城；因为他们必说：这些人像初次在我们面前逃跑。所以我们要在他们面前逃跑，
8.en: They will pursue us until we have lured them away from the city, for they will say, 'They are running away from us as they did before.' So when we flee from them,

8.zh: 你们就从埋伏的地方起来，夺取那城，因为耶和华 ─ 你们的神必把城交在你们手里。
8.en: you are to rise up from ambush and take the city. The Lord your God will give it into your hand.

8.zh: 你们夺了城以后，就放火烧城，要照耶和华的话行。这是我吩咐你们的。
8.en: When you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do what the Lord has commanded. See to it; you have my orders."

8.zh: 约书亚打发他们前往，他们就上埋伏的地方去，住在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边。这夜约书亚却在民中住宿。
8.en: Then Joshua sent them off, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai-but Joshua spent that night with the people.

8.zh: 约书亚清早起来，点齐百姓，他和以色列的长老在百姓前面上艾城去。
8.en: Early the next morning Joshua mustered his men, and he and the leaders of Israel marched before them to Ai.

8.zh: 众民，就是他所带领的兵丁，都上去，向前直往，来到城前，在艾城北边安营。在约书亚和艾城中间有一山谷。
8.en: The entire force that was with him marched up and approached the city and arrived in front of it. They set up camp north of Ai, with the valley between them and the city.

8.zh: 他挑了约有五千人，使他们埋伏在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边，
8.en: Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.

8.zh: 于是安置了百姓，就是城北的全军和城西的伏兵。这夜约书亚进入山谷之中。
8.en: They had the soldiers take up their positions-all those in the camp to the north of the city and the ambush to the west of it. That night Joshua went into the valley.

8.zh: 艾城的王看见这景况，就和全城的人，清早急忙起来，按所定的时候，出到亚拉巴前，要与以色列人交战；王却不知道在城后有伏兵。
8.en: When the king of Ai saw this, he and all the men of the city hurried out early in the morning to meet Israel in battle at a certain place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set against him behind the city.

8.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人在他们面前装败，往那通旷野的路逃跑。
8.en: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be driven back before them, and they fled toward the desert.

8.zh: 城内的众民都被招聚，追赶他们；艾城人追赶的时候，就被引诱离开城。
8.en: All the men of Ai were called to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were lured away from the city.

8.zh: 艾城和伯特利城没有一人不出来追赶以色列人的，撇了敞开的城门，去追赶以色列人。
8.en: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who did not go after Israel. They left the city open and went in pursuit of Israel.

8.zh: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说：你向艾城伸出手里的短枪，因为我要将城交在你手里。约书亚就向城伸出手里的短枪。
8.en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Hold out toward Ai the javelin that is in your hand, for into your hand I will deliver the city." So Joshua held out his javelin toward Ai.

8.zh: 他一伸手，伏兵就从埋伏的地方急忙起来，夺了城，跑进城去，放火焚烧。
8.en: As soon as he did this, the men in the ambush rose quickly from their position and rushed forward. They entered the city and captured it and quickly set it on fire.

8.zh: 艾城的人回头一看，不料，城中烟气冲天，他们就无力向左向右逃跑。那往旷野逃跑的百姓便转身攻击追赶他们的人。
8.en: The men of Ai looked back and saw the smoke of the city rising against the sky, but they had no chance to escape in any direction, for the Israelites who had been fleeing toward the desert had turned back against their pursuers.

8.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人见伏兵已经夺了城，城中烟气飞腾，就转身回去，击杀艾城的人。
8.en: For when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that smoke was going up from the city, they turned around and attacked the men of Ai.

8.zh: 伏兵也出城迎击艾城人，艾城人就困在以色列人中间，前后都是以色列人。于是以色列人击杀他们，没有留下一个，也没有一个逃脱的，
8.en: The men of the ambush also came out of the city against them, so that they were caught in the middle, with Israelites on both sides. Israel cut them down, leaving them neither survivors nor fugitives.

8.zh: 生擒了艾城的王，将他解到约书亚那里。
8.en: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.

8.zh: 以色列人在田间和旷野杀尽所追赶一切艾城的居民。艾城人倒在刀下，直到灭尽；以色列众人就回到艾城，用刀杀了城中的人。
8.en: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai in the fields and in the desert where they had chased them, and when every one of them had been put to the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and killed those who were in it.

8.zh: 当日杀毙的人，连男带女共有一万二千，就是艾城所有的人。
8.en: Twelve thousand men and women fell that day-all the people of Ai.

8.zh: 约书亚没有收回手里所伸出来的短枪，直到把艾城的一切居民尽行杀灭。
8.en: For Joshua did not draw back the hand that held out his javelin until he had destroyed all who lived in Ai.

8.zh: 惟独城中的牲畜和财物，以色列人都取为自己的掠物，是照耶和华所吩咐约书亚的话。
8.en: But Israel did carry off for themselves the livestock and plunder of this city, as the Lord had instructed Joshua.

8.zh: 约书亚将艾城焚烧，使城永为高堆 、 荒场，直到今日；
8.en: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent heap of ruins, a desolate place to this day.

8.zh: 又将艾城王挂在树上，直到晚上。日落的时候，约书亚吩咐人把尸首从树上取下来，丢在城门口，在尸首上堆成一大堆石头，直存到今日。
8.en: He hung the king of Ai on a tree and left him there until evening. At sunset, Joshua ordered them to take his body from the tree and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And they raised a large pile of rocks over it, which remains to this day.

8.zh: 那时，约书亚在以巴路山上为耶和华 ─ 以色列的神筑一座坛，
8.en: Then Joshua built on Mount Ebal an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel,

8.zh: 是用没有动过铁器的整石头筑的，照著耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐以色列人的话，正如摩西律法书上所写的。众人在这坛上给耶和华奉献燔祭和平安祭。
8.en: as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses-an altar of uncut stones, on which no iron tool had been used. On it they offered to the Lord burnt offerings and sacrificed fellowship offerings.

8.zh: 约书亚在那里，当著以色列人面前，将摩西所写的律法抄写在石头上。
8.en: There, in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua copied on stones the law of Moses, which he had written.

8.zh: 以色列众人，无论是本地人 、 是寄居的，和长老 、 官长，并审判官，都站在约柜两旁，在抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未人面前，一半对著基利心山，一半对著以巴路山，为以色列民祝福，正如耶和华仆人摩西先前所吩咐的。
8.en: All Israel, aliens and citizens alike, with their elders, officials and judges, were standing on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the Lord , facing those who carried it-the priests, who were Levites. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the Lord had formerly commanded when he gave instructions to bless the people of Israel.

8.zh: 随后，约书亚将律法上祝福 、 咒诅的话，照著律法书上一切所写的，都宣读了一遍。
8.en: Afterward, Joshua read all the words of the law-the blessings and the curses-just as it is written in the Book of the Law.

8.zh: 摩西所吩咐的一切话，约书亚在以色列全会众和妇女 、 孩子，并他们中间寄居的外人面前，没有一句不宣读的。
8.en: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua did not read to the whole assembly of Israel, including the women and children, and the aliens who lived among them.

9.zh: 约但河西，住山地 、 高原，并对著利巴嫩山沿大海一带的诸王，就是赫人 、 亚摩利人 、 迦南人 、 比利洗人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人的诸王，听见这事，
9.en: Now when all the kings west of the Jordan heard about these things-those in the hill country, in the western foothills, and along the entire coast of the Great Sea as far as Lebanon (the kings of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites)-

9.zh: 就都聚集，同心合意的要与约书亚和以色列人争战。
9.en: they came together to make war against Joshua and Israel.

9.zh: 基遍的居民听见约书亚向耶利哥和艾城所行的事，
9.en: However, when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,

9.zh: 就设诡计，假充使者，拿旧口袋和破裂缝补的旧皮酒袋驮在驴上，
9.en: they resorted to a ruse: They went as a delegation whose donkeys were loaded with worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.

9.zh: 将补过的旧鞋穿在脚上，把旧衣服穿在身上；他们所带的饼都是干的，长了霉了。
9.en: The men put worn and patched sandals on their feet and wore old clothes. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

9.zh: 他们到吉甲营中见约书亚，对他和以色列人说：我们是从远方来的，现在求你与我们立约。
9.en: Then they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the men of Israel, "We have come from a distant country; make a treaty with us."

9.zh: 以色列人对这些希未人说：只怕你们是住在我们中间的；若是这样，怎能和你们立约呢？
9.en: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, "But perhaps you live near us. How then can we make a treaty with you?"

9.zh: 他们对约书亚说：我们是你的仆人。约书亚问他们说：你们是甚么人？是从那里来的？
9.en: "We are your servants," they said to Joshua. But Joshua asked, "Who are you and where do you come from?"

9.zh: 他们回答说：仆人从极远之地而来，是因听见耶和华 ─ 你神的名声和他在埃及所行的一切事，
9.en: They answered: "Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the fame of the Lord your God. For we have heard reports of him: all that he did in Egypt,

9.zh: 并他向约但河东的两个亚摩利王，就是希实本王西宏和在亚斯他录的巴珊王噩一切所行的事。
9.en: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan-Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

9.zh: 我们的长老和我们那地的一切居民对我们说：你们手里要带著路上用的食物去迎接以色列人，对他们说：我们是你们的仆人；现在求你们与我们立约。
9.en: And our elders and all those living in our country said to us, 'Take provisions for your journey; go and meet them and say to them, "We are your servants; make a treaty with us." '

9.zh: 我们出来要往你们这里来的日子，从家里带出来的这饼还是热的；看哪，现在都干了，长了霉了。
9.en: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But now see how dry and moldy it is.

9.zh: 这皮酒袋，我们盛酒的时候还是新的；看哪，现在已经破裂。我们这衣服和鞋，因为道路甚远，也都穿旧了。
9.en: And these wineskins that we filled were new, but see how cracked they are. And our clothes and sandals are worn out by the very long journey."

9.zh: 以色列人受了他们些食物，并没有求问耶和华。
9.en: The men of Israel sampled their provisions but did not inquire of the Lord .

9.zh: 于是约书亚与他们讲和，与他们立约，容他们活著；会众的首领也向他们起誓。
9.en: Then Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the assembly ratified it by oath.

9.zh: 以色列人与他们立约之后，过了三天才听见他们是近邻，住在以色列人中间的。
9.en: Three days after they made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites heard that they were neighbors, living near them.

9.zh: 以色列人起行，第三天到了他们的城邑，就是基遍 、 基非拉 、 比录 、 基列耶琳。
9.en: So the Israelites set out and on the third day came to their cities: Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth and Kiriath Jearim.

9.zh: 因为会众的首领已经指著耶和华 ─ 以色列的神向他们起誓，所以以色列人不击杀他们；全会众就向首领发怨言。
9.en: But the Israelites did not attack them, because the leaders of the assembly had sworn an oath to them by the Lord , the God of Israel. The whole assembly grumbled against the leaders,

9.zh: 众首领对全会众说：我们已经指著耶和华 ─ 以色列的神向他们起誓，现在我们不能害他们。
9.en: but all the leaders answered, "We have given them our oath by the Lord , the God of Israel, and we cannot touch them now.

9.zh: 我们要如此待他们，容他们活著，免得有忿怒因我们所起的誓临到我们身上。
9.en: This is what we will do to them: We will let them live, so that wrath will not fall on us for breaking the oath we swore to them."

9.zh: 首领又对会众说：要容他们活著。于是他们为全会众作了劈柴挑水的人，正如首领对他们所说的话。
9.en: They continued, "Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers for the entire community." So the leaders' promise to them was kept.

9.zh: 约书亚召了他们来，对他们说：为甚么欺哄我们说我们离你们甚远呢？其实你们是住在我们中间。
9.en: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said, "Why did you deceive us by saying, 'We live a long way from you,' while actually you live near us?

9.zh: 现在你们是被咒诅的！你们中间的人必断不了作奴仆，为我神的殿作劈柴挑水的人。
9.en: You are now under a curse: You will never cease to serve as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God."

9.zh: 他们回答约书亚说：因为有人实在告诉你的仆人，耶和华 ─ 你的神曾吩咐他的仆人摩西，把这全地赐给你们，并在你们面前灭绝这地的一切居民，所以我们为你们的缘故甚怕丧命，就行了这事。
9.en: They answered Joshua, "Your servants were clearly told how the Lord your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you the whole land and to wipe out all its inhabitants from before you. So we feared for our lives because of you, and that is why we did this.

9.zh: 现在我们在你手中，你以怎样待我们为善为正，就怎样做罢！
9.en: We are now in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you."

9.zh: 于是约书亚这样待他们，救他们脱离以色列人的手，以色列人就没有杀他们。
9.en: So Joshua saved them from the Israelites, and they did not kill them.

9.zh: 当日约书亚使他们在耶和华所要选择的地方，为会众和耶和华的坛作劈柴挑水的人，直到今日。
9.en: That day he made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers for the community and for the altar of the Lord at the place the Lord would choose. And that is what they are to this day.

10.zh: 耶路撒冷王亚多尼洗德听见约书亚夺了艾城，尽行毁灭，怎样待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也照样待艾城和艾城的王，又听见基遍的居民与以色列人立了和约，住在他们中间，
10.en: Now Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had taken Ai and totally destroyed it, doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king, and that the people of Gibeon had made a treaty of peace with Israel and were living near them.

10.zh: 就甚惧怕；因为基遍是一座大城，如都城一般，比艾城更大，并且城内的人都是勇士。
10.en: He and his people were very much alarmed at this, because Gibeon was an important city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were good fighters.

10.zh: 所以耶路撒冷王亚多尼洗德打发人去见希伯仑王何咸 、 耶末王毘兰 、 拉吉王雅非亚，和伊矶伦王底璧，说：
10.en: So Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem appealed to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish and Debir king of Eglon.

10.zh: 求你们上来帮助我，我们好攻打基遍，因为他们与约书亚和以色列人立了和约。
10.en: "Come up and help me attack Gibeon," he said, "because it has made peace with Joshua and the Israelites."

10.zh: 于是五个亚摩利王，就是耶路撒冷王 、 希伯仑王 、 耶末王 、 拉吉王 、 伊矶伦王，大家聚集，率领他们的众军上去，对著基遍安营，攻打基遍。
10.en: Then the five kings of the Amorites-the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon-joined forces. They moved up with all their troops and took up positions against Gibeon and attacked it.

10.zh: 基遍人就打发人往吉甲的营中去见约书亚，说：你不要袖手不顾你的仆人，求你速速上来拯救我们，帮助我们，因为住山地亚摩利人的诸王都聚集攻击我们。
10.en: The Gibeonites then sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: "Do not abandon your servants. Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us, because all the Amorite kings from the hill country have joined forces against us."

10.zh: 于是约书亚和他一切兵丁，并大能的勇士，都从吉甲上去。
10.en: So Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his entire army, including all the best fighting men.

10.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：不要怕他们；因为我已将他们交在你手里，他们无一人能在你面前站立得住。
10.en: The Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them; I have given them into your hand. Not one of them will be able to withstand you."

10.zh: 约书亚就终夜从吉甲上去，猛然临到他们那里。
10.en: After an all-night march from Gilgal, Joshua took them by surprise.

10.zh: 耶和华使他们在以色列人面前溃乱。约书亚在基遍大大的杀败他们，追赶他们，在伯和仑的上坡路击杀他们，直到亚西加和玛基大。
10.en: The Lord threw them into confusion before Israel, who defeated them in a great victory at Gibeon. Israel pursued them along the road going up to Beth Horon and cut them down all the way to Azekah and Makkedah.

10.zh: 他们在以色列人面前逃跑，正在伯和仑下坡的时候，耶和华从天上降大冰雹在他们身上，（冰雹原文作石头）直降到亚西加，打死他们。被冰雹打死的，比以色列人用刀杀死的还多。
10.en: As they fled before Israel on the road down from Beth Horon to Azekah, the Lord hurled large hailstones down on them from the sky, and more of them died from the hailstones than were killed by the swords of the Israelites.

10.zh: 当耶和华将亚摩利人交付以色列人的日子，约书亚就祷告耶和华，在以色列人眼前说：日头阿，你要停在基遍；月亮阿，你要止在亚雅仑谷。
10.en: On the day the Lord gave the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua said to the Lord in the presence of Israel: "O sun, stand still over Gibeon, O moon, over the Valley of Aijalon."

10.zh: 于是日头停留，月亮止住，直等国民向敌人报仇。这事岂不是写在雅煞珥书上么？日头在天当中停住，不急速下落，约有一日之久。
10.en: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, till the nation avenged itself on its enemies, as it is written in the Book of Jashar. The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.

10.zh: 在这日以前，这日以后，耶和华听人的祷告，没有像这日的，是因耶和华为以色列争战。
10.en: There has never been a day like it before or since, a day when the Lord listened to a man. Surely the Lord was fighting for Israel!

10.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人回到吉甲的营中。
10.en: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.

10.zh: 那五王逃跑，藏在玛基大洞里。
10.en: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.

10.zh: 有人告诉约书亚说：那五王已经找到了，都藏在玛基大洞里。
10.en: When Joshua was told that the five kings had been found hiding in the cave at Makkedah,

10.zh: 约书亚说：你们把几块大石头辊到洞口，派人看守，
10.en: he said, "Roll large rocks up to the mouth of the cave, and post some men there to guard it.

10.zh: 你们却不可耽延，要追赶你们的仇敌，击杀他们尽后边的人，不容他们进自己的城邑，因为耶和华 ─ 你们的神已经把他们交在你们手里。
10.en: But don't stop! Pursue your enemies, attack them from the rear and don't let them reach their cities, for the Lord your God has given them into your hand."

10.zh: 约书亚和以色列人大大杀败他们，直到将他们灭尽；其中剩下的人都进了坚固的城。
10.en: So Joshua and the Israelites destroyed them completely-almost to a man-but the few who were left reached their fortified cities.

10.zh: 众百姓就安然回玛基大营中，到约书亚那里。没有一人敢向以色列人饶舌。
10.en: The whole army then returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one uttered a word against the Israelites.

10.zh: 约书亚说：打开洞口，将那五王从洞里带出来，领到我面前。
10.en: Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me."

10.zh: 众人就这样行，将那五王，就是耶路撒冷王 、 希伯仑王 、 耶末王 、 拉吉王 、 伊矶伦王，从洞里带出来，领到约书亚面前。
10.en: So they brought the five kings out of the cave- the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon.

10.zh: 带出那五王到约书亚面前的时候，约书亚就召了以色列众人来，对那些和他同去的军长说：你们近前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。他们就近前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。
10.en: When they had brought these kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had come with him, "Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings." So they came forward and placed their feet on their necks.

10.zh: 约书亚对他们说：你们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。应当刚强壮胆，因为耶和华必这样待你们所要攻打的一切仇敌。
10.en: Joshua said to them, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Be strong and courageous. This is what the Lord will do to all the enemies you are going to fight."

10.zh: 随后约书亚将这五王杀死，挂在五棵树上。他们就在树上直挂到晚上。
10.en: Then Joshua struck and killed the kings and hung them on five trees, and they were left hanging on the trees until evening.

10.zh: 日头要落的时候，约书亚一吩咐，人就把尸首从树上取下来，丢在他们藏过的洞里，把几块大石头放在洞口，直存到今日。
10.en: At sunset Joshua gave the order and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had been hiding. At the mouth of the cave they placed large rocks, which are there to this day.

10.zh: 当日，约书亚夺了玛基大，用刀击杀城中的人和王；将其中一切人口尽行杀灭，没有留下一个。他待玛基大王，像从前待耶利哥王一样。
10.en: That day Joshua took Makkedah. He put the city and its king to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it. He left no survivors. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

10.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从玛基大往立拿去，攻打立拿。
10.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked it.

10.zh: 耶和华将立拿和立拿的王也交在以色列人手里。约书亚攻打这城，用刀击杀了城中的一切人口，没有留下一个。他待立拿王，像从前待耶利哥王一样。
10.en: The Lord also gave that city and its king into Israel's hand. The city and everyone in it Joshua put to the sword. He left no survivors there. And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

10.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从立拿往拉吉去，对著拉吉安营，攻打这城。
10.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish; he took up positions against it and attacked it.

10.zh: 耶和华将拉吉交在以色列人的手里。第二天约书亚就夺了拉吉，用刀击杀了城中的一切人口，是照他向立拿一切所行的。
10.en: The Lord handed Lachish over to Israel, and Joshua took it on the second day. The city and everyone in it he put to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.

10.zh: 那时基色王荷兰上来帮助拉吉，约书亚就把他和他的民都击杀了，没有留下一个。
10.en: Meanwhile, Horam king of Gezer had come up to help Lachish, but Joshua defeated him and his army-until no survivors were left.

10.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从拉吉往伊矶伦去，对著伊矶伦安营，攻打这城。
10.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Lachish to Eglon; they took up positions against it and attacked it.

10.zh: 当日就夺了城，用刀击杀了城中的人。那日，约书亚将城中的一切人口尽行杀灭，是照他向拉吉一切所行的。
10.en: They captured it that same day and put it to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it, just as they had done to Lachish.

10.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从伊矶伦上希伯仑去，攻打这城，
10.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.

10.zh: 就夺了希伯仑和属希伯仑的诸城邑，用刀将城中的人与王，并那些城邑中的人口，都击杀了，没有留下一个，是照他向伊矶伦所行的，把城中的一切人口尽行杀灭。
10.en: They took the city and put it to the sword, together with its king, its villages and everyone in it. They left no survivors. Just as at Eglon, they totally destroyed it and everyone in it.

10.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人回到底璧，攻打这城，
10.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned around and attacked Debir.

10.zh: 就夺了底璧和属底璧的城邑，又擒获底璧的王，用刀将这些城中的人口尽行杀灭，没有留下一个。他待底璧和底璧王，像从前待希伯仑和立拿与立拿王一样。
10.en: They took the city, its king and its villages, and put them to the sword. Everyone in it they totally destroyed. They left no survivors. They did to Debir and its king as they had done to Libnah and its king and to Hebron.

10.zh: 这样，约书亚击杀全地的人，就是山地 、 南地 、 高原 、 山坡的人，和那些地的诸王，没有留下一个。将凡有气息的尽行杀灭，正如耶和华 ─ 以色列的神所吩咐的。
10.en: So Joshua subdued the whole region, including the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills and the mountain slopes, together with all their kings. He left no survivors. He totally destroyed all who breathed, just as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded.

10.zh: 约书亚从加低斯巴尼亚攻击到迦萨，又攻击歌珊全地，直到基遍。
10.en: Joshua subdued them from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza and from the whole region of Goshen to Gibeon.

10.zh: 约书亚一时杀败了这些王，并夺了他们的地，因为耶和华 ─ 以色列的神为以色列争战。
10.en: All these kings and their lands Joshua conquered in one campaign, because the Lord , the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

10.zh: 于是约书亚和以色列众人回到吉甲的营中。
10.en: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.

11.zh: 夏琐王耶宾听见这事，就打发人去见玛顿王约巴 、 伸仑王 、 押煞王，
11.en: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of this, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Acshaph,

11.zh: 与北方山地 、 基尼烈南边的亚拉巴高原，并西边多珥山冈的诸王；
11.en: and to the northern kings who were in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Kinnereth, in the western foothills and in Naphoth Dor on the west;

11.zh: 又去见东方和西方的迦南人，与山地的亚摩利人 、 赫人 、 比利洗人 、 耶布斯人，并黑门山根米斯巴地的希未人。
11.en: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites below Hermon in the region of Mizpah.

11.zh: 这些王和他们的众军都出来，人数多如海边的沙，并有许多马匹车辆。
11.en: They came out with all their troops and a large number of horses and chariots-a huge army, as numerous as the sand on the seashore.

11.zh: 这诸王会合，来到米伦水边，一同安营，要与以色列人争战。
11.en: All these kings joined forces and made camp together at the Waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

11.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：你不要因他们惧怕。明日这时，我必将他们交付以色列人全然杀了。你要砍断他们马的蹄筋，用火焚烧他们的车辆。
11.en: The Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them, because by this time tomorrow I will hand all of them over to Israel, slain. You are to hamstring their horses and burn their chariots."

11.zh: 于是约书亚率领一切兵丁，在米伦水边突然向前攻打他们。
11.en: So Joshua and his whole army came against them suddenly at the Waters of Merom and attacked them,

11.zh: 耶和华将他们交在以色列人手里，以色列人就击杀他们，追赶他们到西顿大城，到米斯利弗玛音，直到东边米斯巴的平原，将他们击杀，没有留下一个。
11.en: and the Lord gave them into the hand of Israel. They defeated them and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon, to Misrephoth Maim, and to the Valley of Mizpah on the east, until no survivors were left.

11.zh: 约书亚就照耶和华所吩咐他的去行，砍断他们马的蹄筋，用火焚烧他们的车辆。
11.en: Joshua did to them as the Lord had directed: He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots.

11.zh: 当时，约书亚转回夺了夏琐，用刀击杀夏琐王。（素来夏琐在这诸国中是为首的。）
11.en: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword. (Hazor had been the head of all these kingdoms.)

11.zh: 以色列人用刀击杀城中的人口，将他们尽行杀灭；凡有气息的没有留下一个。约书亚又用火焚烧夏琐。
11.en: Everyone in it they put to the sword. They totally destroyed them, not sparing anything that breathed, and he burned up Hazor itself.

11.zh: 约书亚夺了这些王的一切城邑，擒获其中的诸王，用刀击杀他们，将他们尽行杀灭，正如耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐的。
11.en: Joshua took all these royal cities and their kings and put them to the sword. He totally destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.

11.zh: 至于造在山冈上的城，除了夏琐以外，以色列人都没有焚烧。约书亚只将夏琐焚烧了。
11.en: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds-except Hazor, which Joshua burned.

11.zh: 那些城邑所有的财物和牲畜，以色列人都取为自己的掠物；惟有一切人口都用刀击杀，直到杀尽；凡有气息的没有留下一个。
11.en: The Israelites carried off for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but all the people they put to the sword until they completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed.

11.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐他仆人摩西，摩西就照样吩咐约书亚，约书亚也照样行。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，约书亚没有一件懈怠不行的。
11.en: As the Lord commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua did it; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.

11.zh: 约书亚夺了那全地，就是山地 、 一带南地 、 歌珊全地 、 高原 、 亚拉巴 、 以色列的山地，和山下的高原。
11.en: So Joshua took this entire land: the hill country, all the Negev, the whole region of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah and the mountains of Israel with their foothills,

11.zh: 从上西珥的哈拉山，直到黑门山下利巴嫩平原的巴力迦得，并且擒获那些地的诸王，将他们杀死。
11.en: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, to Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and struck them down, putting them to death.

11.zh: 约书亚和这诸王争战了许多年日。
11.en: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long time.

11.zh: 除了基遍的希未人之外，没有一城与以色列人讲和的，都是以色列人争战夺来的。
11.en: Except for the Hivites living in Gibeon, not one city made a treaty of peace with the Israelites, who took them all in battle.

11.zh: 因为耶和华的意思是要使他们心里刚硬，来与以色列人争战，好叫他们尽被杀灭，不蒙怜悯，正如耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
11.en: For it was the Lord himself who hardened their hearts to wage war against Israel, so that he might destroy them totally, exterminating them without mercy, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

11.zh: 当时约书亚来到，将住山地 、 希伯仑 、 底璧 、 亚拿伯 、 犹大山地 、 以色列山地所有的亚衲族人剪除了。约书亚将他们和他们的城邑尽都毁灭。
11.en: At that time Joshua went and destroyed the Anakites from the hill country: from Hebron, Debir and Anab, from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua totally destroyed them and their towns.

11.zh: 在以色列人的地没有留下一个亚衲族人，只在迦萨 、 迦特，和亚实突有留下的。
11.en: No Anakites were left in Israelite territory; only in Gaza, Gath and Ashdod did any survive.

11.zh: 这样，约书亚照著耶和华所吩咐摩西的一切话夺了那全地，就按著以色列支派的宗族将地分给他们为业。于是国中太平，没有争战了。
11.en: So Joshua took the entire land, just as the Lord had directed Moses, and he gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their tribal divisions. Then the land had rest from war.

12.zh: 以色列人在约但河外向日出之地击杀二王，得他们的地，就是从亚嫩谷直到黑门山，并东边的全亚拉巴之地。
12.en: These are the kings of the land whom the Israelites had defeated and whose territory they took over east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon, including all the eastern side of the Arabah:

12.zh: 这二王，有住希实本 、 亚摩利人的王西宏。他所管之地是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，并基列一半，直到亚扪人的境界，雅博河
12.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge-from the middle of the gorge-to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites. This included half of Gilead.

12.zh: 与约但河东边的亚拉巴，直到基尼烈海，又到亚拉巴的海，就是盐海，通伯耶西末的路，以及南方，直到毘斯迦的山根。
12.en: He also ruled over the eastern Arabah from the Sea of Kinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ), to Beth Jeshimoth, and then southward below the slopes of Pisgah.

12.zh: 又有巴珊王噩。他是利乏音人所剩下的，住在亚斯他录和以得来。
12.en: And the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaites, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei.

12.zh: 他所管之地是黑门山 、 撒迦 、 巴珊全地，直到基述人和玛迦人的境界，并基列一半，直到希实本王西宏的境界。
12.en: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, all of Bashan to the border of the people of Geshur and Maacah, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

12.zh: 这二王是耶和华仆人摩西和以色列人所击杀的；耶和华仆人摩西将他们的地赐给流便人 、 迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人为业。
12.en: Moses, the servant of the Lord , and the Israelites conquered them. And Moses the servant of the Lord gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh to be their possession.

12.zh: 约书亚和以色列人在约但河西击杀了诸王。他们的地是从利巴嫩平原的巴力迦得，直到上西珥的哈拉山。约书亚就将那地按著以色列支派的宗族分给他们为业，
12.en: These are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (their lands Joshua gave as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions-

12.zh: 就是赫人 、 亚摩利人，迦南人 、 比利洗人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人的山地 、 高原亚拉巴 、 山坡 、 旷野，和南地。
12.en: the hill country, the western foothills, the Arabah, the mountain slopes, the desert and the Negev-the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites):

12.zh: 他们的王：一个是耶利哥王，一个是靠近伯特利的艾城王，
12.en: the king of Jericho one the king of Ai (near Bethel) one

12.zh: 一个是耶路撒冷王，一个是希伯仑王，
12.en: the king of Jerusalem one the king of Hebronp one

12.zh: 一个是耶末王，一个是拉吉王，
12.en: the king of Jarmuth one the king of Lachish one

12.zh: 一个是伊矶伦王，一个是基色王，
12.en: the king of Eglon one the king of Gezer one

12.zh: 一个是底璧王，一个是基德王，
12.en: the king of Debir one the king of Geder one

12.zh: 一个是何珥玛王，一个是亚拉得王，
12.en: the king of Hormah one the king of Arad one

12.zh: 一个是立拿王，一个是亚杜兰王，
12.en: the king of Libnah one the king of Adullam one

12.zh: 一个是玛基大王，一个是伯特利王，
12.en: the king of Makkedah one the king of Bethel one

12.zh: 一个是他普亚王，一个是希弗王，
12.en: the king of Tappuah one the king of Hepher one

12.zh: 一个是亚弗王，一个是拉沙仑王，
12.en: the king of Aphek one the king of Lasharon one

12.zh: 一个是玛顿王，一个是夏琐王，
12.en: the king of Madon one the king of Hazor one

12.zh: 一个是伸仑米仑王，一个是押煞王，
12.en: the king of Shimron Meron one the king of Acshaph one

12.zh: 一个是他纳王，一个是米吉多王，
12.en: the king of Taanach one the king of Megiddo one

12.zh: 一个是基低斯王，一个是靠近迦密的约念王，
12.en: the king of Kedesh one the king of Jokneam in Carmel one

12.zh: 一个是多珥山冈的多珥王，一个是吉甲的戈印王，
12.en: the king of Dor (in Naphoth Dor ) one the king of Goyim in Gilgal one

12.zh: 一个是得撒王；共计三十一个王。
12.en: the king of Tirzah one thirty-one kings in all.

13.zh: 约书亚年纪老迈，耶和华对他说：你年纪老迈了，还有许多未得之地，
13.en: When Joshua was old and well advanced in years, the Lord said to him, "You are very old, and there are still very large areas of land to be taken over.

13.zh: 就是非利士人的全境和基述人的全地。
13.en: "This is the land that remains: all the regions of the Philistines and Geshurites:

13.zh: 从埃及前的西曷河往北，直到以革伦的境界，就算属迦南人之地。有非利士人五个首领所管的迦萨人 、 亚实突人 、 亚实基伦人 、 迦特人 、 以革伦人之地，并有南方亚卫人之地。
13.en: from the Shihor River on the east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north, all of it counted as Canaanite (the territory of the five Philistine rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron-that of the Avvites);

13.zh: 又有迦南人的全地，并属西顿人的米亚拉到亚弗，直到亚摩利人的境界。
13.en: from the south, all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah of the Sidonians as far as Aphek, the region of the Amorites,

13.zh: 还有迦巴勒人之地，并向日出的全利巴嫩，就是从黑门山根的巴力迦得，直到哈马口。
13.en: the area of the Gebalites ; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

13.zh: 山地的一切居民，从利巴嫩直到米斯利弗玛音，就是所有的西顿人，我必在以色列人面前赶出他们去。你只管照我所吩咐的，将这地拈阄分给以色列人为业。
13.en: "As for all the inhabitants of the mountain regions from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, that is, all the Sidonians, I myself will drive them out before the Israelites. Be sure to allocate this land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have instructed you,

13.zh: 现在你要把这地分给九个支派和玛拿西半个支派为业。
13.en: and divide it as an inheritance among the nine tribes and half of the tribe of Manasseh."

13.zh: 玛拿西那半支派和流便 、 迦得二支派已经受了产业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约但河东所赐给他们的：
13.en: The other half of Manasseh, the Reubenites and the Gadites had received the inheritance that Moses had given them east of the Jordan, as he, the servant of the Lord , had assigned it to them.

13.zh: 是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，并米底巴的全平原，直到底本，
13.en: It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and included the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,

13.zh: 和在希实本作王亚摩利王西宏的诸城，直到亚扪人的境界；
13.en: and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites.

13.zh: 又有基列地 、 基述人 、 玛迦人的地界，并黑门全山 、 巴珊全地，直到撒迦；
13.en: It also included Gilead, the territory of the people of Geshur and Maacah, all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salecah-

13.zh: 又有巴珊王噩的全国 ─ 他在亚斯他录和以得来作王（利乏音人所存留的只剩下他）。这些地的人都是摩西所击杀 、 所赶逐的。
13.en: that is, the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and had survived as one of the last of the Rephaites. Moses had defeated them and taken over their land.

13.zh: 以色列人却没有赶逐基述人 、 玛迦人；这些人仍住在以色列中，直到今日。
13.en: But the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maacah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.

13.zh: 只是利未支派，摩西（原文作他）没有把产业分给他们。他们的产业乃是献与耶和华 ─ 以色列神的火祭，正如耶和华所应许他们的。
13.en: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance, since the offerings made by fire to the Lord , the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as he promised them.

13.zh: 摩西按著流便支派的宗族分给他们产业。
13.en: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Reuben, clan by clan:

13.zh: 他们的境界是亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，靠近米底巴的全平原；
13.en: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau past Medeba

13.zh: 希实本并属希实本平原的各城，底本 、 巴末巴力 、 伯巴力勉 、
13.en: to Heshbon and all its towns on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

13.zh: 雅杂 、 基底莫 、 米法押 、
13.en: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

13.zh: 基列亭 、 西比玛 、 谷中山的细列哈沙辖 、
13.en: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley,

13.zh: 伯毘珥 、 毘斯迦山坡 、 伯耶西末；
13.en: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth

13.zh: 平原的各城，并亚摩利王西宏的全国。这西宏曾在希实本作王，摩西把他和米甸的族长以未 、 利金 、 苏珥 、 户珥 、 利巴击杀了；这都是住那地属西宏为首领的。
13.en: -all the towns on the plateau and the entire realm of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled at Heshbon. Moses had defeated him and the Midianite chiefs, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba-princes allied with Sihon-who lived in that country.

13.zh: 那时以色列人在所杀的人中，也用刀杀了比珥的儿子术士巴兰。
13.en: In addition to those slain in battle, the Israelites had put to the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.

13.zh: 流便人的境界就是约但河与靠近约但河的地。以上是流便人按著宗族所得为业的诸城，并属城的村庄。
13.en: The boundary of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Reubenites, clan by clan.

13.zh: 摩西按著迦得支派的宗族分给他们产业。
13.en: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Gad, clan by clan:

13.zh: 他们的境界是雅谢和基列的各城，并亚扪人的一半地，直到拉巴前的亚罗珥；
13.en: The territory of Jazer, all the towns of Gilead and half the Ammonite country as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;

13.zh: 从希实本到拉抹米斯巴和比多宁，又从玛哈念到底璧的境界，
13.en: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir;

13.zh: 并谷中的伯亚兰 、 伯宁拉 、 疏割 、 撒分，就是希实本王西宏国中的余地，以及约但河与靠近约但河的地，直到基尼烈海的极边，都在约但河东。
13.en: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth and Zaphon with the rest of the realm of Sihon king of Heshbon (the east side of the Jordan, the territory up to the end of the Sea of Kinnereth ).

13.zh: 以上是迦得人按著宗族所得为业的诸城，并属城的村庄。
13.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Gadites, clan by clan.

13.zh: 摩西把产业分给玛拿西半支派，是按著玛拿西半支派的宗族所分的。
13.en: This is what Moses had given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the family of the descendants of Manasseh, clan by clan:

13.zh: 他们的境界是从玛哈念起，包括巴珊全地，就是巴珊王噩的全国，并在巴珊 、 睚珥的一切城邑，共六十个。
13.en: The territory extending from Mahanaim and including all of Bashan, the entire realm of Og king of Bashan-all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns,

13.zh: 基列的一半，并亚斯他录 、 以得来，就是属巴珊王噩国的二城，是按著宗族给玛拿西的儿子玛吉的一半子孙。
13.en: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei (the royal cities of Og in Bashan). This was for the descendants of Makir son of Manasseh-for half of the sons of Makir, clan by clan.

13.zh: 以上是摩西在约但河东对著耶利哥的摩押平原所分给他们的产业。
13.en: This is the inheritance Moses had given when he was in the plains of Moab across the Jordan east of Jericho.

13.zh: 只是利未支派，摩西没有把产业分给他们。耶和华 ─ 以色列的神是他们的产业，正如耶和华所应许他们的。
13.en: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses had given no inheritance; the Lord , the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he promised them.

14.zh: 以色列人在迦南地所得的产业，就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长所分给他们的，都记在下面，
14.en: Now these are the areas the Israelites received as an inheritance in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel allotted to them.

14.zh: 是照耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的，把产业拈阄分给九个半支派。
14.en: Their inheritances were assigned by lot to the nine-and-a-half tribes, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.

14.zh: 原来，摩西在约但河东已经把产业分给那两个半支派，只是在他们中间没有把产业分给利未人。
14.en: Moses had granted the two-and-a-half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan but had not granted the Levites an inheritance among the rest,

14.zh: 因为约瑟的子孙是两个支派，就是玛拿西和以法莲，所以没有把地分给利未人，但给他们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野，可以牧养他们的牲畜，安置他们的财物。
14.en: for the sons of Joseph had become two tribes-Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites received no share of the land but only towns to live in, with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.

14.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就照样行，把地分了。
14.en: So the Israelites divided the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

14.zh: 那时，犹大人来到吉甲见约书亚，有基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒对约书亚说：耶和华在加低斯巴尼亚指著我与你对神人摩西所说的话，你都知道了。
14.en: Now the men of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You know what the Lord said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh Barnea about you and me.

14.zh: 耶和华的仆人摩西从加低斯巴尼亚打发我窥探这地，那时我正四十岁；我按著心意回报他。
14.en: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh Barnea to explore the land. And I brought him back a report according to my convictions,

14.zh: 然而，同我上去的众弟兄使百姓的心消化；但我专心跟从耶和华 ─ 我的神。
14.en: but my brothers who went up with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear. I, however, followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.

14.zh: 当日摩西起誓说：你脚所踏之地定要归你和你的子孙永远为业，因为你专心跟从耶和华 ─ 我的神。
14.en: So on that day Moses swore to me, 'The land on which your feet have walked will be your inheritance and that of your children forever, because you have followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.'

14.zh: 自从耶和华对摩西说这话的时候，耶和华照他所应许的使我存活这四十五年；其间以色列人在旷野行走。看哪，现今我八十五岁了，
14.en: "Now then, just as the Lord promised, he has kept me alive for forty-five years since the time he said this to Moses, while Israel moved about in the desert. So here I am today, eighty-five years old!

14.zh: 我还是强壮，像摩西打发我去的那天一样；无论是争战，是出入，我的力量那时如何，现在还是如何。
14.en: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I'm just as vigorous to go out to battle now as I was then.

14.zh: 求你将耶和华那日应许我的这山地给我；那里有亚衲族人，并宽大坚固的城，你也曾听见了。或者耶和华照他所应许的与我同在，我就把他们赶出去。
14.en: Now give me this hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You yourself heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified, but, the Lord helping me, I will drive them out just as he said."

14.zh: 于是约书亚为耶孚尼的儿子迦勒祝福，将希伯仑给他为业。
14.en: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.

14.zh: 所以希伯仑作了基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒的产业，直到今日，因为他专心跟从耶和华 ─ 以色列的神。
14.en: So Hebron has belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite ever since, because he followed the Lord , the God of Israel, wholeheartedly.

14.zh: 希伯仑从前名叫基列亚巴；亚巴是亚衲族中最尊大的人。于是国中太平，没有争战了。
14.en: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath Arba after Arba, who was the greatest man among the Anakites.) Then the land had rest from war.

15.zh: 犹大支派按著宗族拈阄所得之地是在尽南边，到以东的交界，向南直到寻的旷野。
15.en: The allotment for the tribe of Judah, clan by clan, extended down to the territory of Edom, to the Desert of Zin in the extreme south.

15.zh: 他们的南界是从盐海的尽边，就是从朝南的海汊起，
15.en: Their southern boundary started from the bay at the southern end of the Salt Sea,

15.zh: 通到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，上到加低斯巴尼亚的南边，又过希斯仑，上到亚达珥，绕到甲加，
15.en: crossed south of Scorpion Pass, continued on to Zin and went over to the south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it ran past Hezron up to Addar and curved around to Karka.

15.zh: 接连到押们，通到埃及小河，直通到海为止。这就是他们的南界。
15.en: It then passed along to Azmon and joined the Wadi of Egypt, ending at the sea. This is their southern boundary.

15.zh: 东界是从盐海南边到约但河口。北界是从约但河口的海汊起，
15.en: The eastern boundary is the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern boundary started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,

15.zh: 上到伯曷拉，过伯亚拉巴的北边，上到流便之子波罕的磐石；
15.en: went up to Beth Hoglah and continued north of Beth Arabah to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

15.zh: 从亚割谷往北，上到底璧，直向河南亚都冥坡对面的吉甲；又接连到隐示麦泉，直通到隐罗结，
15.en: The boundary then went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor and turned north to Gilgal, which faces the Pass of Adummim south of the gorge. It continued along to the waters of En Shemesh and came out at En Rogel.

15.zh: 上到欣嫩子谷，贴近耶布斯的南界（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）；又上到欣嫩谷西边的山顶，就是在利乏音谷极北的边界；
15.en: Then it ran up the Valley of Ben Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem). From there it climbed to the top of the hill west of the Hinnom Valley at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.

15.zh: 又从山顶延到尼弗多亚的水源，通到以弗仑山的城邑，又延到巴拉（巴拉就是基列耶琳）；
15.en: From the hilltop the boundary headed toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, came out at the towns of Mount Ephron and went down toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath Jearim).

15.zh: 又从巴拉往西绕到西珥山，接连到耶琳山的北边（耶琳就是基撒仑）；又下到伯示麦过亭纳，
15.en: Then it curved westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Kesalon), continued down to Beth Shemesh and crossed to Timnah.

15.zh: 通到以革伦北边，延到施基仑，接连到巴拉山；又通到雅比聂，直通到海为止。
15.en: It went to the northern slope of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, passed along to Mount Baalah and reached Jabneel. The boundary ended at the sea.

15.zh: 西界就是大海和靠近大海之地。这是犹大人按著宗族所得之地四围的交界。
15.en: The western boundary is the coastline of the Great Sea. These are the boundaries around the people of Judah by their clans.

15.zh: 约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，将犹大人中的一段地，就是基列亚巴，分给耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖（基列亚巴就是希伯仑）。
15.en: In accordance with the Lord 's command to him, Joshua gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion in Judah-Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

15.zh: 迦勒就从那里赶出亚衲族的三个族长，就是示筛 、 亚希幔 、 挞买；
15.en: From Hebron Caleb drove out the three Anakites-Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai-descendants of Anak.

15.zh: 又从那里上去，攻击底璧的居民。（这底璧从前名叫基列西弗。）
15.en: From there he marched against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

15.zh: 迦勒说：谁能攻打基列西弗将城夺取，我就把我女儿押撒给他为妻。
15.en: And Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher."

15.zh: 迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他为妻。
15.en: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.

15.zh: 押撒过门的时候，劝丈夫向他父亲求一块田，押撒一下驴，迦勒问他说：你要甚么？
15.en: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"

15.zh: 他说：求你赐福给我，你既将我安置在南地，求你也给我水泉。他父亲就把上泉下泉赐给他。
15.en: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

15.zh: 以下是犹大支派按著宗族所得的产业。
15.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, clan by clan:

15.zh: 犹大支派尽南边的城邑，与以东交界相近的，就是甲薛 、 以得 、 雅姑珥 、
15.en: The southernmost towns of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the boundary of Edom were: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

15.zh: 基拿 、 底摩拿 、 亚大达 、
15.en: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

15.zh: 基低斯 、 夏琐 、 以提楠 、
15.en: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

15.zh: 西弗 、 提炼 、 比亚绿 、
15.en: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

15.zh: 夏琐哈大他 、 加略希斯仑（加略希斯仑就是夏琐） 、
15.en: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (that is, Hazor),

15.zh: 亚曼 、 示玛 、 摩拉大 、
15.en: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

15.zh: 哈萨迦大 、 黑实门 、 伯帕列 、
15.en: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

15.zh: 哈萨书亚 、 别是巴 、 比斯约他 、
15.en: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

15.zh: 巴拉 、 以因 、 以森 、
15.en: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

15.zh: 伊勒多腊 、 基失 、 何珥玛 、
15.en: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,

15.zh: 洗革拉 、 麦玛拿 、 三撒拿 、
15.en: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

15.zh: 利巴勿 、 实忻 、 亚因 、 临门，共二十九座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain and Rimmon-a total of twenty-nine towns and their villages.

15.zh: 在高原有以实陶 、 琐拉 、 亚实拿 、
15.en: In the western foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

15.zh: 撒挪亚 、 隐干宁 、 他普亚 、 以楠 、
15.en: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

15.zh: 耶末 、 亚杜兰 、 梭哥 、 亚西加 、
15.en: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

15.zh: 沙拉音 、 亚底他音 、 基底拉 、 基底罗他音，共十四座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim) -fourteen towns and their villages.

15.zh: 又有洗楠 、 哈大沙 、 麦大迦得 、
15.en: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

15.zh: 底连 、 米斯巴 、 约帖 、
15.en: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

15.zh: 拉吉 、 波斯加 、 伊矶伦 、
15.en: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

15.zh: 迦本 、 拉幔 、 基提利 、
15.en: Cabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish,

15.zh: 基低罗 、 伯大衮 、 拿玛 、 玛基大，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah and Makkedah-sixteen towns and their villages.

15.zh: 又有立拿 、 以帖 、 亚珊 、
15.en: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

15.zh: 益弗他 、 亚实拿 、 尼悉 、
15.en: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

15.zh: 基伊拉 、 亚革悉 、 玛利沙，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Keilah, Aczib and Mareshah-nine towns and their villages.

15.zh: 又有以革伦和属以革伦的镇市村庄；
15.en: Ekron, with its surrounding settlements and villages;

15.zh: 从以革伦直到海，一切靠近亚实突之地，并属其地的村庄。
15.en: west of Ekron, all that were in the vicinity of Ashdod, together with their villages;

15.zh: 亚实突和属亚实突的镇市村庄；迦萨和属迦萨的镇市村庄；直到埃及小河，并大海和靠近大海之地。
15.en: Ashdod, its surrounding settlements and villages; and Gaza, its settlements and villages, as far as the Wadi of Egypt and the coastline of the Great Sea.

15.zh: 在山地有沙密 、 雅提珥 、 梭哥 、
15.en: In the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

15.zh: 大拿 、 基列萨拿（基列萨拿就是底璧） 、
15.en: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (that is, Debir),

15.zh: 亚拿伯 、 以实提莫 、 亚念 、
15.en: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

15.zh: 歌珊 、 何伦 、 基罗，共十一座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Goshen, Holon and Giloh-eleven towns and their villages.

15.zh: 又有亚拉 、 度玛 、 以珊 、
15.en: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

15.zh: 雅农 、 伯他普亚 、 亚非加 、
15.en: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

15.zh: 宏他 、 基列亚巴（基列亚巴就是希伯仑） 、 洗珥，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) and Zior-nine towns and their villages.

15.zh: 又有玛云 、 迦密 、 西弗 、 淤他 、
15.en: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,

15.zh: 耶斯列 、 约甸 、 撒挪亚 、
15.en: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

15.zh: 该隐 、 基比亚 、 亭纳，共十座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Kain, Gibeah and Timnah-ten towns and their villages.

15.zh: 又有哈忽 、 伯夙 、 基突 、
15.en: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

15.zh: 玛腊 、 伯亚诺 、 伊勒提君，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Maarath, Beth Anoth and Eltekon-six towns and their villages.

15.zh: 又有基列巴力（基列巴力就是基列耶琳） 、 拉巴，共两座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim) and Rabbah-two towns and their villages.

15.zh: 在旷野有伯亚拉巴 、 密丁 、 西迦迦 、
15.en: In the desert: Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

15.zh: 匿珊 、 盐城 、 隐基底，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Nibshan, the City of Salt and En Gedi-six towns and their villages.

15.zh: 至于住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，犹大人不能把他们赶出去，耶布斯人却在耶路撒冷与犹大人同住，直到今日。
15.en: Judah could not dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the people of Judah.

16.zh: 约瑟的子孙拈阄所得之地是从靠近耶利哥的约但河起，以耶利哥东边的水为界：从耶利哥上去，通过山地的旷野，到伯特利；
16.en: The allotment for Joseph began at the Jordan of Jericho, east of the waters of Jericho, and went up from there through the desert into the hill country of Bethel.

16.zh: 又从伯特利到路斯，接连到亚基人的境界，至亚他绿；
16.en: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz), crossed over to the territory of the Arkites in Ataroth,

16.zh: 又往西下到押利提人的境界，到下伯和仑的境界，直到基色，通到海为止。
16.en: descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as the region of Lower Beth Horon and on to Gezer, ending at the sea.

16.zh: 约瑟的儿子玛拿西 、 以法莲就得了他们的地业。
16.en: So Manasseh and Ephraim, the descendants of Joseph, received their inheritance.

16.zh: 以法莲子孙的境界，按著宗族所得的，记在下面：他们地业的东界是亚他绿亚达到上伯和仑；
16.en: This was the territory of Ephraim, clan by clan: The boundary of their inheritance went from Ataroth Addar in the east to Upper Beth Horon

16.zh: 往西通到北边的密米他，又向东绕到他纳示罗，又接连到雅挪哈的东边；
16.en: and continued to the sea. From Micmethath on the north it curved eastward to Taanath Shiloh, passing by it to Janoah on the east.

16.zh: 从雅挪哈下到亚他绿，又到拿拉，达到耶利哥，通到约但河为止；
16.en: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho and came out at the Jordan.

16.zh: 从他普亚往西，到加拿河，直通到海为止。这就是以法莲支派按著宗族所得的地业。
16.en: From Tappuah the border went west to the Kanah Ravine and ended at the sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites, clan by clan.

16.zh: 另外在玛拿西人地业中得了些城邑和属城的村庄。这都是分给以法莲子孙的。
16.en: It also included all the towns and their villages that were set aside for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites.

16.zh: 他们没有赶出住基色的迦南人；迦南人却住在以法莲人中间，成为作苦工的仆人，直到今日。
16.en: They did not dislodge the Canaanites living in Gezer; to this day the Canaanites live among the people of Ephraim but are required to do forced labor.

17.zh: 玛拿西是约瑟的长子，他的支派拈阄所得之地记在下面。至于玛拿西的长子基列之父（父或作：主）玛吉，因为是勇士就得了基列和巴珊。
