17.en: This was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph's firstborn, that is, for Makir, Manasseh's firstborn. Makir was the ancestor of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because the Makirites were great soldiers.

17.zh: 玛拿西其余的子孙，按著宗族拈阄分地，就是亚比以谢子孙，希勒子孙，亚斯列子孙，示剑子孙，希弗子孙，示米大子孙；这些按著宗族，都是约瑟儿子玛拿西子孙的男丁。
17.en: So this allotment was for the rest of the people of Manasseh-the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph by their clans.

17.zh: 玛拿西的元孙，玛吉的曾孙，基列的孙子，希弗的儿子西罗非哈没有儿子，只有女儿。他的女儿名叫玛拉 、 挪阿 、 曷拉 、 密迦 、 得撒；
17.en: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons but only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.

17.zh: 他们来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚并众首领面前，说：耶和华曾吩咐摩西在我们弟兄中分给我们产业。于是约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，在他们伯叔中，把产业分给他们。
17.en: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders and said, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers." So Joshua gave them an inheritance along with the brothers of their father, according to the Lord 's command.

17.zh: 除了约但河东的基列和巴珊地之外，还有十分地归玛拿西，
17.en: Manasseh's share consisted of ten tracts of land besides Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan,

17.zh: 因为玛拿西的孙女们在玛拿西的孙子中得了产业。基列地是属玛拿西其余的子孙。
17.en: because the daughters of the tribe of Manasseh received an inheritance among the sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the descendants of Manasseh.

17.zh: 玛拿西的境界：从亚设起，到示剑前的密米他，往北到隐他普亚居民之地。
17.en: The territory of Manasseh extended from Asher to Micmethath east of Shechem. The boundary ran southward from there to include the people living at En Tappuah.

17.zh: 他普亚地归玛拿西，只是玛拿西境界上的他普亚城归以法莲子孙。
17.en: (Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah itself, on the boundary of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.)

17.zh: 其界下到加拿河的南边。在玛拿西城邑中的这些城邑都归以法莲。玛拿西的地界是在河北直通到海为止；
17.en: Then the boundary continued south to the Kanah Ravine. There were towns belonging to Ephraim lying among the towns of Manasseh, but the boundary of Manasseh was the northern side of the ravine and ended at the sea.

17.zh: 南归以法莲，北归玛拿西，以海为界；北边到亚设，东边到以萨迦。
17.en: On the south the land belonged to Ephraim, on the north to Manasseh. The territory of Manasseh reached the sea and bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.

17.zh: 玛拿西在以萨迦和亚设境内，有伯善和属伯善的镇市，以伯莲和属以伯莲的镇市，多珥的居民和属多珥的镇市；又有三处山冈，就是隐多珥和属隐多珥的镇市；他纳的居民和属他纳的镇市，米吉多的居民和属米吉多的镇市。
17.en: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth Shan, Ibleam and the people of Dor, Endor, Taanach and Megiddo, together with their surrounding settlements (the third in the list is Naphoth ).

17.zh: 只是玛拿西子孙不能赶出这些城的居民，迦南人偏要住在那地。
17.en: Yet the Manassites were not able to occupy these towns, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that region.

17.zh: 及至以色列人强盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，没有把他们全然赶出。
17.en: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they subjected the Canaanites to forced labor but did not drive them out completely.

17.zh: 约瑟的子孙对约书亚说：耶和华到如今既然赐福与我们，我们也族大人多，你为甚么仅将一阄一段之地分给我们为业呢？
17.en: The people of Joseph said to Joshua, "Why have you given us only one allotment and one portion for an inheritance? We are a numerous people and the Lord has blessed us abundantly."

17.zh: 约书亚说：你们如果族大人多，嫌以法莲山地窄小，就可以上比利洗人 、 利乏音人之地，在树林中砍伐树木。
17.en: "If you are so numerous," Joshua answered, "and if the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaites."

17.zh: 约瑟的子孙说：那山地容不下我们，并且住平原的迦南人，就是住伯善和属伯善的镇市，并住耶斯列平原的人，都有铁车。
17.en: The people of Joseph replied, "The hill country is not enough for us, and all the Canaanites who live in the plain have iron chariots, both those in Beth Shan and its settlements and those in the Valley of Jezreel."

17.zh: 约书亚对约瑟家，就是以法莲和玛拿西人，说：你是族大人多，并且强盛，不可仅有一阄之地，
17.en: But Joshua said to the house of Joseph-to Ephraim and Manasseh-"You are numerous and very powerful. You will have not only one allotment

17.zh: 山地也要归你，虽是树林，你也可以砍伐；靠近之地必归你。迦南人虽有铁车，虽是强盛，你也能把他们赶出去。
17.en: but the forested hill country as well. Clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours; though the Canaanites have iron chariots and though they are strong, you can drive them out."

18.zh: 以色列的全会众都聚集在示罗，把会幕设立在那里，那地已经被他们制伏了。
18.en: The whole assembly of the Israelites gathered at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The country was brought under their control,

18.zh: 以色列人中其余的七个支派还没有分给他们地业。
18.en: but there were still seven Israelite tribes who had not yet received their inheritance.

18.zh: 约书亚对以色列人说：耶和华 ─ 你们列祖的神所赐给你们的地，你们耽延不去得，要到几时呢？
18.en: So Joshua said to the Israelites: "How long will you wait before you begin to take possession of the land that the Lord , the God of your fathers, has given you?

18.zh: 你们每支派当选举三个人，我要打发他们去，他们就要起身走遍那地，按著各支派应得的地业写明（或作：画图），就回到我这里来。
18.en: Appoint three men from each tribe. I will send them out to make a survey of the land and to write a description of it, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me.

18.zh: 他们要将地分做七分；犹大仍在南方，住在他的境内。约瑟家仍在北方，住在他的境内。
18.en: You are to divide the land into seven parts. Judah is to remain in its territory on the south and the house of Joseph in its territory on the north.

18.zh: 你们要将地分做七分，写明了拿到我这里来。我要在耶和华 ─ 我们神面前，为你们拈阄。
18.en: After you have written descriptions of the seven parts of the land, bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you in the presence of the Lord our God.

18.zh: 利未人在你们中间没有分，因为供耶和华祭司的职任就是他们的产业。迦得支派 、 流便支派，和玛拿西半支派已经在约但河东得了地业，就是耶和华仆人摩西所给他们的。
18.en: The Levites, however, do not get a portion among you, because the priestly service of the Lord is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan. Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to them."

18.zh: 划地势的人起身去的时候，约书亚嘱咐他们说：你们去走遍那地，划明地势，就回到我这里来。我要在示罗这里，耶和华面前，为你们拈阄。
18.en: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua instructed them, "Go and make a survey of the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh in the presence of the Lord ."

18.zh: 他们就去了，走遍那地，按著城邑分做七分，写在册子上，回到示罗营中见约书亚。
18.en: So the men left and went through the land. They wrote its description on a scroll, town by town, in seven parts, and returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

18.zh: 约书亚就在示罗，耶和华面前，为他们拈阄。约书亚在那里，按著以色列人的支派，将地分给他们。
18.en: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the Lord , and there he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their tribal divisions.

18.zh: 便雅悯支派，按著宗族拈阄所得之地，是在犹大 、 约瑟子孙中间。
18.en: The lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:

18.zh: 他们的北界是从约但河起，往上贴近耶利哥的北边；又往西通过山地，直到伯亚文的旷野；
18.en: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan, passed the northern slope of Jericho and headed west into the hill country, coming out at the desert of Beth Aven.

18.zh: 从那里往南接连到路斯，贴近路斯（路斯就是伯特利），又下到亚他绿亚达，靠近下伯和仑南边的山；
18.en: From there it crossed to the south slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth Addar on the hill south of Lower Beth Horon.

18.zh: 从那里往西，又转向南，从伯和仑南对面的山，直达到犹大人的城基列巴力（基列巴力就是基列耶琳）；这是西界。
18.en: From the hill facing Beth Horon on the south the boundary turned south along the western side and came out at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town of the people of Judah. This was the western side.

18.zh: 南界是从基列耶琳的尽边起，往西达到尼弗多亚的水源；
18.en: The southern side began at the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim on the west, and the boundary came out at the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

18.zh: 又下到欣嫩子谷对面山的尽边，就是利乏音谷北边的山；又下到欣嫩谷，贴近耶布斯的南边；又下到隐罗结；
18.en: The boundary went down to the foot of the hill facing the Valley of Ben Hinnom, north of the Valley of Rephaim. It continued down the Hinnom Valley along the southern slope of the Jebusite city and so to En Rogel.

18.zh: 又往北通到隐示麦，达到亚都冥坡对面的基利绿；又下到流便之子波罕的磐石；
18.en: It then curved north, went to En Shemesh, continued to Geliloth, which faces the Pass of Adummim, and ran down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

18.zh: 又接连到亚拉巴对面，往北下到亚拉巴；
18.en: It continued to the northern slope of Beth Arabah and on down into the Arabah.

18.zh: 又接连到伯曷拉的北边，直通到盐海的北汊，就是约但河的南头；这是南界。
18.en: It then went to the northern slope of Beth Hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan in the south. This was the southern boundary.

18.zh: 东界是约但河。这是便雅悯人按著宗族，照他们四围的交界所得的地业。
18.en: The Jordan formed the boundary on the eastern side. These were the boundaries that marked out the inheritance of the clans of Benjamin on all sides.

18.zh: 便雅悯支派按著宗族所得的城邑就是：耶利哥 、 伯曷拉 、 伊麦基悉 、
18.en: The tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan, had the following cities: Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

18.zh: 伯亚拉巴 、 洗玛脸 、 伯特利 、
18.en: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

18.zh: 亚文 、 巴拉 、 俄弗拉 、
18.en: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

18.zh: 基法阿摩尼 、 俄弗尼 、 迦巴，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄；
18.en: Kephar Ammoni, Ophni and Geba-twelve towns and their villages.

18.zh: 又有基遍 、 拉玛 、 比录 、
18.en: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

18.zh: 米斯巴 、 基非拉 、 摩撒 、
18.en: Mizpah, Kephirah, Mozah,

18.zh: 利坚 、 伊利毘勒 、 他拉拉 、
18.en: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

18.zh: 洗拉 、 以利弗 、 耶布斯（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷） 、 基比亚 、 基列，共十四座城，还有属城的村庄。这是便雅悯人按著宗族所得的地业。
18.en: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath-fourteen towns and their villages. This was the inheritance of Benjamin for its clans.

19.zh: 为西缅支派的人，按著宗族，拈出第二阄。他们所得的地业是在犹大人地业中间。
19.en: The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon, clan by clan. Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah.

19.zh: 他们所得为业之地就是：别是巴（或名示巴） 、 摩拉大 、
19.en: It included: Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

19.zh: 哈萨书亚 、 巴拉 、 以森 、
19.en: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

19.zh: 伊利多拉 、 比土力 、 何珥玛 、
19.en: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

19.zh: 洗革拉 、 伯玛加博 、 哈萨苏撒 、
19.en: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

19.zh: 伯利巴勿 、 沙鲁险，共十三座城，还有属城的村庄；
19.en: Beth Lebaoth and Sharuhen-thirteen towns and their villages;

19.zh: 又有亚因 、 利门 、 以帖 、 亚珊，共四座城，还有属城的村庄；
19.en: Ain, Rimmon, Ether and Ashan-four towns and their villages-

19.zh: 并有这些城邑四围一切的村庄，直到巴拉比珥，就是南地的拉玛。这是西缅支派按著宗族所得的地业。
19.en: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath Beer (Ramah in the Negev). This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Simeonites, clan by clan.

19.zh: 西缅人的地业是从犹大人地业中得来的；因为犹大人的分过多，所以西缅人在他们的地业中得了地业。
19.en: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the share of Judah, because Judah's portion was more than they needed. So the Simeonites received their inheritance within the territory of Judah.

19.zh: 为西布伦人，按著宗族，拈出第三阄。他们地业的境界是到撒立；
19.en: The third lot came up for Zebulun, clan by clan: The boundary of their inheritance went as far as Sarid.

19.zh: 往西上到玛拉拉，达到大巴设，又达到约念前的河；
19.en: Going west it ran to Maralah, touched Dabbesheth, and extended to the ravine near Jokneam.

19.zh: 又从撒立往东转向日出之地，到吉斯绿他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亚；
19.en: It turned east from Sarid toward the sunrise to the territory of Kisloth Tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.

19.zh: 从那里往东，接连到迦特希弗，至以特加汛，通到临门，临门延到尼亚；
19.en: Then it continued eastward to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin; it came out at Rimmon and turned toward Neah.

19.zh: 又绕过尼亚的北边，转到哈拿顿，通到伊弗他伊勒谷。
19.en: There the boundary went around on the north to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah El.

19.zh: 还有加他 、 拿哈拉 、 伸仑 、 以大拉 、 伯利恒，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄。
19.en: Included were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem. There were twelve towns and their villages.

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是西布伦人按著宗族所得的地业。
19.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of Zebulun, clan by clan.

19.zh: 为以萨迦人，按著宗族，拈出第四阄。
19.en: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, clan by clan.

19.zh: 他们的境界是到耶斯列 、 基苏律 、 书念 、
19.en: Their territory included: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,

19.zh: 哈弗连 、 示按 、 亚拿哈拉 、
19.en: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

19.zh: 拉璧 、 基善 、 亚别 、
19.en: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

19.zh: 利篾 、 隐干宁 、 隐哈大 、 伯帕薛；
19.en: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez.

19.zh: 又达到他泊 、 沙哈洗玛 、 伯示麦，直通到约但河为止，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。
19.en: The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth Shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen towns and their villages.

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是以萨迦支派按著宗族所得的地业。
19.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, clan by clan.

19.zh: 为亚设支派，按著宗族，拈出第五阄。
19.en: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher, clan by clan.

19.zh: 他们的境界是黑甲 、 哈利 、 比田 、 押煞 、
19.en: Their territory included: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Acshaph,

19.zh: 亚拉米勒 、 亚末 、 米沙勒；往西达到迦密，又到希曷立纳，
19.en: Allammelech, Amad and Mishal. On the west the boundary touched Carmel and Shihor Libnath.

19.zh: 转向日出之地，到伯大衮，达到细步纶往北到伊弗他伊勒谷，到伯以墨和尼业，也通到迦步勒的左边；
19.en: It then turned east toward Beth Dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El, and went north to Beth Emek and Neiel, passing Cabul on the left.

19.zh: 又到义伯仑 、 利合 、 哈们 、 加拿，直到西顿大城；
19.en: It went to Abdon, Rehob, Hammon and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.

19.zh: 转到拉玛和坚固城推罗；又转到何萨，靠近亚革悉一带地方，直通到海；
19.en: The boundary then turned back toward Ramah and went to the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah and came out at the sea in the region of Aczib,

19.zh: 又有乌玛 、 亚弗 、 利合，共二十二座城，还有属城的村庄。
19.en: Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages.

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是亚设支派按著宗族所得的地业。
19.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Asher, clan by clan.

19.zh: 为拿弗他利人，按著宗族，拈出第六阄。
19.en: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali, clan by clan:

19.zh: 他们的境界是从希利弗从撒拿音的橡树，从亚大米尼吉和雅比聂，直到拉共，通到约但河；
19.en: Their boundary went from Heleph and the large tree in Zaanannim, passing Adami Nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.

19.zh: 又转向西到亚斯纳他泊，从那里通到户割，南边到西布伦，西边到亚设，又向日出之地，达到约但河那里的犹大。
19.en: The boundary ran west through Aznoth Tabor and came out at Hukkok. It touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west and the Jordan on the east.

19.zh: 坚固的城就是：西丁 、 侧耳 、 哈末 、 拉甲 、 基尼烈 、
19.en: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnereth,

19.zh: 亚大玛 、 拉玛 、 夏琐 、
19.en: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

19.zh: 基低斯 、 以得来 、 隐夏琐 、
19.en: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

19.zh: 以利稳 、 密大伊勒 、 和琏 、 伯亚纳 、 伯示麦，共十九座城，还有属城的村庄。
19.en: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath and Beth Shemesh. There were nineteen towns and their villages.

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是拿弗他利支派按著宗族所得的地业。
19.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali, clan by clan.

19.zh: 为但支派，按著宗族，拈出第七阄。
19.en: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of Dan, clan by clan.

19.zh: 他们地业的境界是琐拉 、 以实陶 、 伊珥示麦 、
19.en: The territory of their inheritance included: Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,

19.zh: 沙拉宾 、 亚雅仑 、 伊提拉 、
19.en: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

19.zh: 以伦 、 亭拿他 、 以革伦 、
19.en: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

19.zh: 伊利提基 、 基比顿 、 巴拉 、
19.en: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

19.zh: 伊胡得 、 比尼比拉 、 迦特临门 、
19.en: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

19.zh: 美耶昆 、 拉昆，并约帕对面的地界。
19.en: Me Jarkon and Rakkon, with the area facing Joppa.

19.zh: 但人的地界越过原得的地界；因为但人上去攻取利善，用刀击杀城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他们先祖但的名将利善改名为但。
19.en: (But the Danites had difficulty taking possession of their territory, so they went up and attacked Leshem, took it, put it to the sword and occupied it. They settled in Leshem and named it Dan after their forefather.)

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是但支派按著宗族所得的地业。
19.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, clan by clan.

19.zh: 以色列人按著境界分完了地业，就在他们中间将地给嫩的儿子约书亚为业，
19.en: When they had finished dividing the land into its allotted portions, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them,

19.zh: 是照耶和华的吩咐，将约书亚所求的城，就是以法莲山地的亭拿西拉城，给了他。他就修那城，住在其中。
19.en: as the Lord had commanded. They gave him the town he asked for-Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim. And he built up the town and settled there.

19.zh: 这就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长，在示罗会幕门口，耶和华面前，拈阄所分的地业。这样，他们把地分完了。
19.en: These are the territories that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel assigned by lot at Shiloh in the presence of the Lord at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. And so they finished dividing the land.

20.en: Then the Lord said to Joshua:

20.zh: 你吩咐以色列人说：你们要照著我藉摩西所晓谕你们的，为自己设立逃城，
20.en: "Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,

20.zh: 使那无心而误杀人的，可以逃到那里。这些城可以作你们逃避报血仇人的地方。
20.en: so that anyone who kills a person accidentally and unintentionally may flee there and find protection from the avenger of blood.

20.zh: 那杀人的要逃到这些城中的一座城，站在城门口，将他的事情说给城内的长老们听。他们就把他收进城里，给他地方，使他住在他们中间。
20.en: "When he flees to one of these cities, he is to stand in the entrance of the city gate and state his case before the elders of that city. Then they are to admit him into their city and give him a place to live with them.

20.zh: 若是报血仇的追了他来，长老不可将他交在报血仇的手里；因为他是素无仇恨，无心杀了人的。
20.en: If the avenger of blood pursues him, they must not surrender the one accused, because he killed his neighbor unintentionally and without malice aforethought.

20.zh: 他要住在那城里，站在会众面前听审判，等到那时的大祭司死了，杀人的才可以回到本城本家，就是他所逃出来的那城。
20.en: He is to stay in that city until he has stood trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest who is serving at that time. Then he may go back to his own home in the town from which he fled."

20.zh: 于是，以色列人在拿弗他利山地分定加利利的基低斯；在以法莲山地分定示剑；在犹大山地分定基列亚巴（基列亚巴就是希伯仑）；
20.en: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

20.zh: 又在约但河外耶利哥东，从流便支派中，在旷野的平原，设立比悉；从迦得支派中设立基列的拉末；从玛拿西支派中设立巴珊的哥兰。
20.en: On the east side of the Jordan of Jericho they designated Bezer in the desert on the plateau in the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead in the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan in the tribe of Manasseh.

20.zh: 这都是为以色列众人和在他们中间寄居的外人所分定的地邑，使误杀人的都可以逃到那里，不死在报血仇人的手中，等他站在会众面前听审判。
20.en: Any of the Israelites or any alien living among them who killed someone accidentally could flee to these designated cities and not be killed by the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.

21.zh: 那时，利未人的众族长来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长面前，
21.en: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribal families of Israel

21.zh: 在迦南地的示罗对他们说：从前耶和华藉著摩西吩咐给我们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野可以牧养我们的牲畜。
21.en: at Shiloh in Canaan and said to them, "The Lord commanded through Moses that you give us towns to live in, with pasturelands for our livestock."

21.zh: 于是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐的，从自己的地业中，将以下所记的城邑和城邑的郊野给了利未人。
21.en: So, as the Lord had commanded, the Israelites gave the Levites the following towns and pasturelands out of their own inheritance:

21.zh: 为哥辖族拈阄：利未人的祭司 、 亚伦的子孙，从犹大支派 、 西缅支派 、 便雅悯支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。
21.en: The first lot came out for the Kohathites, clan by clan. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.

21.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙，从以法莲支派 、 但支派 、 玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十座城。
21.en: The rest of Kohath's descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan and half of Manasseh.

21.zh: 革顺的子孙，从以萨迦支派 、 亚设支派 、 拿弗他利支派 、 住巴珊的玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。
21.en: The descendants of Gershon were allotted thirteen towns from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

21.zh: 米拉利的子孙，按著宗族，从流便支派 、 迦得支派 、 西布伦支派的地业中，按阄得了十二座城。
21.en: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

21.zh: 以色列人照著耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的，将这些城邑和城邑的郊野，按阄分给利未人。
21.en: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these towns and their pasturelands, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.

21.zh: 从犹大支派 、 西缅支派的地业中，将以下所记的城给了利未支派哥辖宗族亚伦的子孙；因为给他们拈出头一阄，
21.en: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they allotted the following towns by name

21.zh: a
21.en: (these towns were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them):

21.zh: 将犹大山地的基列亚巴和四围的郊野给了他们。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖。（基列亚巴就是希伯仑）。
21.en: They gave them Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pastureland, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

21.zh: 惟将属城的田地和村庄给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒为业。
21.en: But the fields and villages around the city they had given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.

21.zh: 以色列人将希伯仑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了祭司亚伦的子孙；又给他们立拿和属城的郊野，
21.en: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Libnah,

21.zh: 雅提珥和属城的郊野，以实提莫和属城的郊野，
21.en: Jattir, Eshtemoa,

21.zh: 何仑和属城的郊野，底璧和属城的郊野，
21.en: Holon, Debir,

21.zh: 亚因和属城的郊野，淤他和属城的郊野，伯示麦和属城的郊野，共九座城，都是从这二支派中分出来的。
21.en: Ain, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands-nine towns from these two tribes.

21.zh: 又从便雅悯支派的地业中给了他们基遍和属城的郊野，迦巴和属城的郊野，
21.en: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon, Geba,

21.zh: 亚拿突和属城的郊野，亚勒们和属城的郊野，共四座城。
21.en: Anathoth and Almon, together with their pasturelands-four towns.

21.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的共有十三座城，还有属城的郊野。
21.en: All the towns for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

21.zh: 利未支派中哥辖的宗族，就是哥辖其余的子孙，拈阄所得的城有从以法莲支派中分出来的。
21.en: The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted towns from the tribe of Ephraim:

21.zh: 以色列人将以法莲山地的示剑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们基色和属城的郊野，
21.en: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Gezer,

21.zh: 基伯先和属城的郊野，伯和仑和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Kibzaim and Beth Horon, together with their pasturelands-four towns.

21.zh: 又从但支派的地业中给了他们伊利提基和属城的郊野，基比顿和属城的郊野，
21.en: Also from the tribe of Dan they received Eltekeh, Gibbethon,

21.zh: 亚雅仑和属城的郊野，迦特临门和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands-four towns.

21.zh: 又从玛拿西半支派的地业中给了他们他纳和属城的郊野，迦特临门和属城的郊野，共两座城。
21.en: From half the tribe of Manasseh they received Taanach and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands-two towns.

21.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙共有十座城，还有属城的郊野。
21.en: All these ten towns and their pasturelands were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

21.zh: 以色列人又从玛拿西半支派的地业中将巴珊的哥兰，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了利未支派革顺的子孙；又给他们比施提拉和属城的郊野，共两座城；
21.en: The Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Be Eshtarah, together with their pasturelands-two towns;

21.zh: 又从以萨迦支派的地业中给了他们基善和属城的郊野，大比拉和属城的郊野，
21.en: from the tribe of Issachar, Kishion, Daberath,

21.zh: 耶末和属城的郊野，隐干宁和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Jarmuth and En Gannim, together with their pasturelands-four towns;

21.zh: 又从亚设支派的地业中给了他们米沙勒和属城的郊野，押顿和属城的郊野，
21.en: from the tribe of Asher, Mishal, Abdon,

21.zh: 黑甲和属城的郊野，利合和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Helkath and Rehob, together with their pasturelands-four towns;

21.zh: 又从拿弗他利支派的地业中将加利利的基低斯，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们哈末多珥和属城的郊野，加珥坦和属城的郊野，共三座城。
21.en: from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Hammoth Dor and Kartan, together with their pasturelands-three towns.

21.zh: 革顺人按著宗族所得的城，共十三座，还有属城的郊野。
21.en: All the towns of the Gershonite clans were thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

21.zh: 其余利未支派米拉利子孙，从西布伦支派的地业中所得的，就是约念和属城的郊野，加珥他和属城的郊野，
21.en: The Merarite clans (the rest of the Levites) were given: from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam, Kartah,

21.zh: 丁拿和属城的郊野，拿哈拉和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Dimnah and Nahalal, together with their pasturelands-four towns;

21.zh: 又从流便支派的地业中给了他们比悉和属城的郊野，雅杂和属城的郊野，
21.en: from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer, Jahaz,

21.zh: 基底莫和属城的郊野，米法押和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands-four towns;

21.zh: 又从迦得支派的地业中，将基列的拉末，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们玛哈念和属城的郊野，
21.en: from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Mahanaim,

21.zh: 希实本和属城的郊野，雅谢和属城的郊野，共四座城。
21.en: Heshbon and Jazer, together with their pasturelands-four towns in all.

21.zh: 其余利未支派的人，就是米拉利的子孙，按著宗族拈阄所得的，共十二座城。
21.en: All the towns allotted to the Merarite clans, who were the rest of the Levites, were twelve.

21.zh: 利未人在以色列人的地业中所得的城，共四十八座，并有属城的郊野。
21.en: The towns of the Levites in the territory held by the Israelites were forty-eight in all, together with their pasturelands.

21.zh: 这些城四围都有属城的郊野，城城都是如此。
21.en: Each of these towns had pasturelands surrounding it; this was true for all these towns.

21.zh: 这样，耶和华将从前向他们列祖起誓所应许的全地赐给以色列人，他们就得了为业，住在其中。
21.en: So the Lord gave Israel all the land he had sworn to give their forefathers, and they took possession of it and settled there.

21.zh: 耶和华照著向他们列祖起誓所应许的一切话，使他们四境平安；他们一切仇敌中，没有一人在他们面前站立得住。耶和华把一切仇敌都交在他们手中。
21.en: The Lord gave them rest on every side, just as he had sworn to their forefathers. Not one of their enemies withstood them; the Lord handed all their enemies over to them.

21.zh: 耶和华应许赐福给以色列家的话一句也没有落空，都应验了。
21.en: Not one of all the Lord 's good promises to the house of Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.

22.zh: 当时，约书亚召了流便人 、 迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人来，
22.en: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh

22.zh: 对他们说：耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的，你们都遵守了；我所吩咐你们的，你们也都听从了。
22.en: and said to them, "You have done all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, and you have obeyed me in everything I commanded.

22.zh: 你们这许多日子，总没有撇离你们的弟兄，直到今日，并守了耶和华 ─ 你们神所吩咐你们当守的。
22.en: For a long time now-to this very day-you have not deserted your brothers but have carried out the mission the Lord your God gave you.

22.zh: 如今耶和华 ─ 你们神照著他所应许的，使你们弟兄得享平安，现在可以转回你们的帐棚，到耶和华的仆人摩西在约但河东所赐你们为业之地。
22.en: Now that the Lord your God has given your brothers rest as he promised, return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side of the Jordan.

22.zh: 只要切切的谨慎遵行耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的诫命律法，爱耶和华 ─ 你们的神，行他一切的道，守他的诫命，专靠他，尽心尽性事奉他。
22.en: But be very careful to keep the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you: to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, to obey his commands, to hold fast to him and to serve him with all your heart and all your soul."

22.zh: 于是约书亚为他们祝福，打发他们去，他们就回自己的帐棚去了。
22.en: Then Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their homes.

22.zh: 玛拿西那半支派，摩西早已在巴珊分给他们地业。这半支派，约书亚在约但河西，在他们弟兄中，分给他们地业。约书亚打发他们回帐棚的时候为他们祝福，
22.en: (To the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given land in Bashan, and to the other half of the tribe Joshua gave land on the west side of the Jordan with their brothers.) When Joshua sent them home, he blessed them,

22.zh: 对他们说：你们带许多财物，许多牲畜和金 、 银 、 铜 、 铁，并许多衣服，回你们的帐棚去，要将你们从仇敌夺来的物，与你们众弟兄同分。
22.en: saying, "Return to your homes with your great wealth-with large herds of livestock, with silver, gold, bronze and iron, and a great quantity of clothing-and divide with your brothers the plunder from your enemies."

22.zh: 于是流便人 、 迦得人 、 玛拿西半支派的人从迦南地的示罗起行，离开以色列人，回往他们得为业的基列地，就是照耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的得了为业之地。
22.en: So the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh left the Israelites at Shiloh in Canaan to return to Gilead, their own land, which they had acquired in accordance with the command of the Lord through Moses.

22.zh: 流便人 、 迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人到了靠近约但河的一带迦南地，就在约但河那里筑了一座坛；那坛看著高大。
22.en: When they came to Geliloth near the Jordan in the land of Canaan, the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an imposing altar there by the Jordan.

22.zh: 以色列人听说流便人 、 迦得人 、 玛拿西半支派的人靠近约但河边，在迦南地属以色列人的那边筑了一座坛。
22.en: And when the Israelites heard that they had built the altar on the border of Canaan at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side,

22.zh: 全会众一听见，就聚集在示罗，要上去攻打他们。
22.en: the whole assembly of Israel gathered at Shiloh to go to war against them.

22.zh: 以色列人打发祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，往基列地去见流便人 、 迦得人 、 玛拿西半支派的人；
22.en: So the Israelites sent Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, to the land of Gilead-to Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

22.zh: 又打发十个首领与非尼哈同去，就是以色列每支派的一个首领，都是以色列军中的统领。
22.en: With him they sent ten of the chief men, one for each of the tribes of Israel, each the head of a family division among the Israelite clans.

22.zh: 他们到了基列地，见流便人 、 迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人，对他们说：
22.en: When they went to Gilead-to Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh-they said to them:

22.zh: 耶和华全会众这样说，你们今日转去不跟从耶和华，干犯以色列的神，为自己筑一座坛，悖逆了耶和华，这犯的是甚么罪呢？
22.en: "The whole assembly of the Lord says: 'How could you break faith with the God of Israel like this? How could you turn away from the Lord and build yourselves an altar in rebellion against him now?

22.zh: 从前拜毘珥的罪孽还算小么？虽然瘟疫临到耶和华的会众，到今日我们还没有洗净这罪。
22.en: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us? Up to this very day we have not cleansed ourselves from that sin, even though a plague fell on the community of the Lord !

22.zh: 你们今日竟转去不跟从耶和华么？你们今日既悖逆耶和华，明日他必向以色列全会众发怒。
22.en: And are you now turning away from the Lord ? " 'If you rebel against the Lord today, tomorrow he will be angry with the whole community of Israel.

22.zh: 你们所得为业之地，若嫌不洁净，就可以过到耶和华之地，就是耶和华的帐幕所住之地，在我们中间得地业。只是不可悖逆耶和华，也不可得罪我们，在耶和华 ─ 我们神的坛以外为自己筑坛。
22.en: If the land you possess is defiled, come over to the Lord 's land, where the Lord 's tabernacle stands, and share the land with us. But do not rebel against the Lord or against us by building an altar for yourselves, other than the altar of the Lord our God.

22.zh: 从前谢拉的曾孙亚干岂不是在那当灭的物上犯了罪，就有忿怒临到以色列全会众么？那人在所犯的罪中不独一人死亡。
22.en: When Achan son of Zerah acted unfaithfully regarding the devoted things, did not wrath come upon the whole community of Israel? He was not the only one who died for his sin.' "

22.zh: 于是流便人 、 迦得人 、 玛拿西半支派的人回答以色列军中的统领说：
22.en: Then Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh replied to the heads of the clans of Israel:

22.zh: 大能者神耶和华！大能者神耶和华！他是知道的！以色列人也必知道！我们若有悖逆的意思，或是干犯耶和华（愿你今日不保佑我们），
22.en: "The Mighty One, God, the Lord ! The Mighty One, God, the Lord ! He knows! And let Israel know! If this has been in rebellion or disobedience to the Lord , do not spare us this day.

22.zh: 为自己筑坛，要转去不跟从耶和华，或是要将燔祭 、 素祭 、 平安祭献在坛上，愿耶和华亲自讨我们的罪。
22.en: If we have built our own altar to turn away from the Lord and to offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, or to sacrifice fellowship offerings on it, may the Lord himself call us to account.

22.zh: 我们行这事并非无故，是特意做的，说：恐怕日后你们的子孙对我们的子孙说：你们与耶和华 ─ 以色列的神有何关涉呢？
22.en: "No! We did it for fear that some day your descendants might say to ours, 'What do you have to do with the Lord , the God of Israel?

22.zh: 因为耶和华把约但河定为我们和你们这流便人 、 迦得人的交界，你们与耶和华无分了。这样，你们的子孙就使我们的子孙不再敬畏耶和华了。
22.en: The Lord has made the Jordan a boundary between us and you-you Reubenites and Gadites! You have no share in the Lord .' So your descendants might cause ours to stop fearing the Lord .

22.zh: 因此我们说：不如为自己筑一座坛，不是为献燔祭，也不是为献别的祭，
22.en: "That is why we said, 'Let us get ready and build an altar-but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.'

22.zh: 乃是为你我中间和你我后人中间作证据，好叫我们也在耶和华面前献燔祭 、 平安祭，和别的祭事奉他，免得你们的子孙日后对我们的子孙说，你们与耶和华无分了。
22.en: On the contrary, it is to be a witness between us and you and the generations that follow, that we will worship the Lord at his sanctuary with our burnt offerings, sacrifices and fellowship offerings. Then in the future your descendants will not be able to say to ours, 'You have no share in the Lord .'

22.zh: 所以我们说：日后你们对我们，或对我们的后人这样说，我们就可以回答说，你们看我们列祖所筑的坛是耶和华坛的样式；这并不是为献燔祭，也不是为献别的祭，乃是为作你我中间的证据。
22.en: "And we said, 'If they ever say this to us, or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the Lord 's altar, which our fathers built, not for burnt offerings and sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.'

22.zh: 我们在耶和华 ─ 我们神帐幕前的坛以外，另筑一座坛，为献燔祭 、 素祭，和别的祭，悖逆耶和华，今日转去不跟从他，我们断没有这个意思。
22.en: "Far be it from us to rebel against the Lord and turn away from him today by building an altar for burnt offerings, grain offerings and sacrifices, other than the altar of the Lord our God that stands before his tabernacle."

22.zh: 祭司非尼哈与会中的首领，就是与他同来以色列军中的统领，听见流便人 、 迦得人 、 玛拿西人所说的话，就都以为美。
22.en: When Phinehas the priest and the leaders of the community-the heads of the clans of the Israelites-heard what Reuben, Gad and Manasseh had to say, they were pleased.

22.zh: 祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈对流便人 、 迦得人 、 玛拿西人说：今日我们知道耶和华在我们中间，因为你们没有向他犯了这罪。现在你们救以色列人脱离耶和华的手了。
22.en: And Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, said to Reuben, Gad and Manasseh, "Today we know that the Lord is with us, because you have not acted unfaithfully toward the Lord in this matter. Now you have rescued the Israelites from the Lord 's hand."

22.zh: 祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈与众首领离了流便人 、 迦得人，从基列地回往迦南地，到了以色列人那里，便将这事回报他们。
22.en: Then Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, and the leaders returned to Canaan from their meeting with the Reubenites and Gadites in Gilead and reported to the Israelites.

22.zh: 以色列人以这事为美，就称颂神，不再提上去攻打流便人 、 迦得人 、 毁坏他们所住的地了。
22.en: They were glad to hear the report and praised God. And they talked no more about going to war against them to devastate the country where the Reubenites and the Gadites lived.

22.zh: 流便人 、 迦得人给坛起名叫证坛，意思说：这坛在我们中间证明耶和华是神。
22.en: And the Reubenites and the Gadites gave the altar this name: A Witness Between Us that the Lord is God.

23.zh: 耶和华使以色列人安静，不与四围的一切仇敌争战，已经多日。约书亚年纪老迈，
23.en: After a long time had passed and the Lord had given Israel rest from all their enemies around them, Joshua, by then old and well advanced in years,

23.zh: 就把以色列众人的长老 、 族长 、 审判官，并官长都召了来，对他们说：我年纪已经老迈。
23.en: summoned all Israel-their elders, leaders, judges and officials-and said to them: "I am old and well advanced in years.

23.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你们的神因你们的缘故向那些国所行的一切事，你们亲眼看见了，因那为你们争战的是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
23.en: You yourselves have seen everything the Lord your God has done to all these nations for your sake; it was the Lord your God who fought for you.

23.zh: 我所剪除和所剩下的各国，从约但河起到日落之处的大海，我已经拈阄分给你们各支派为业。
23.en: Remember how I have allotted as an inheritance for your tribes all the land of the nations that remain-the nations I conquered-between the Jordan and the Great Sea in the west.

23.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你们的神必将他们从你们面前赶出去，使他们离开你们，你们就必得他们的地为业，正如耶和华 ─ 你们的神所应许的。
23.en: The Lord your God himself will drive them out of your way. He will push them out before you, and you will take possession of their land, as the Lord your God promised you.

23.zh: 所以，你们要大大壮胆，谨守遵行写在摩西律法书上的一切话，不可偏离左右。
23.en: "Be very strong; be careful to obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, without turning aside to the right or to the left.

23.zh: 不可与你们中间所剩下的这些国民搀杂。他们的神，你们不可提他的名，不可指著他起誓，也不可事奉 、 叩拜；
23.en: Do not associate with these nations that remain among you; do not invoke the names of their gods or swear by them. You must not serve them or bow down to them.

23.zh: 只要照著你们到今日所行的，专靠耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
23.en: But you are to hold fast to the Lord your God, as you have until now.

23.zh: 因为耶和华已经把又大又强的国民从你们面前赶出；直到今日，没有一人在你们面前站立得住。
23.en: "The Lord has driven out before you great and powerful nations; to this day no one has been able to withstand you.

23.zh: 你们一人必追赶千人，因耶和华 ─ 你们的神照他所应许的，为你们争战。
23.en: One of you routs a thousand, because the Lord your God fights for you, just as he promised.

23.zh: 你们要分外谨慎，爱耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
23.en: So be very careful to love the Lord your God.

23.zh: 你们若稍微转去，与你们中间所剩下的这些国民联络，彼此结亲，互相往来，
23.en: "But if you turn away and ally yourselves with the survivors of these nations that remain among you and if you intermarry with them and associate with them,

23.zh: 你们要确实知道，耶和华 ─ 你们的神必不再将他们从你们眼前赶出；他们却要成为你们的网罗 、 机槛 、 肋上的鞭 、 眼中的刺，直到你们在耶和华 ─ 你们神所赐的这美地上灭亡。
23.en: then you may be sure that the Lord your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become snares and traps for you, whips on your backs and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land, which the Lord your God has given you.

23.zh: 我现在要走世人必走的路。你们是一心一意的知道，耶和华 ─ 你们神所应许赐福与你们的话没有一句落空，都应验在你们身上了。
23.en: "Now I am about to go the way of all the earth. You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the Lord your God gave you has failed. Every promise has been fulfilled; not one has failed.

23.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你们神所应许的一切福气怎样临到你们身上，耶和华也必照样使各样祸患临到你们身上，直到把你们从耶和华 ─ 你们神所赐的这美地上除灭。
23.en: But just as every good promise of the Lord your God has come true, so the Lord will bring on you all the evil he has threatened, until he has destroyed you from this good land he has given you.

23.zh: 你们若违背耶和华 ─ 你们神吩咐你们所守的约，去事奉别神，叩拜他，耶和华的怒气必向你们发作，使你们在他所赐的美地上速速灭亡。
23.en: If you violate the covenant of the Lord your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, the Lord 's anger will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from the good land he has given you."

24.zh: 约书亚将以色列的众支派聚集在示剑，召了以色列的长老 、 族长 、 审判官，并官长来，他们就站在神面前。
24.en: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges and officials of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.

24.zh: 约书亚对众民说：耶和华 ─ 以色列的神如此说：古时你们的列祖，就是亚伯拉罕和拿鹤的父亲他拉，住在大河那边事奉别神，
24.en: Joshua said to all the people, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: 'Long ago your forefathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the River and worshiped other gods.

24.zh: 我将你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕从大河那边带来，领他走遍迦南全地，又使他的子孙众多，把以撒赐给他；
24.en: But I took your father Abraham from the land beyond the River and led him throughout Canaan and gave him many descendants. I gave him Isaac,

24.zh: 又把雅各和以扫赐给以撒，将西珥山赐给以扫为业；后来雅各和他的子孙下到埃及去了。
24.en: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I assigned the hill country of Seir to Esau, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

24.zh: 我差遣摩西 、 亚伦，并照我在埃及中所行的降灾与埃及，然后把你们领出来。
24.en: " 'Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and I brought you out.

24.zh: 我领你们列祖出埃及，他们就到了红海；埃及人带领车辆马兵追赶你们列祖到红海。
24.en: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt, you came to the sea, and the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.

24.zh: 你们列祖哀求耶和华，他就使你们和埃及人中间黑暗了，又使海水淹没埃及人。我在埃及所行的事，你们亲眼见过。你们在旷野也住了许多年日。
24.en: But they cried to the Lord for help, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians; he brought the sea over them and covered them. You saw with your own eyes what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the desert for a long time.

24.zh: 我领你们到约但河东亚摩利人所住之地。他们与你们争战，我将他们交在你们手中，你们便得了他们的地为业；我也在你们面前将他们灭绝。
24.en: " 'I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived east of the Jordan. They fought against you, but I gave them into your hands. I destroyed them from before you, and you took possession of their land.

24.zh: 那时，摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒起来攻击以色列人，打发人召了比珥的儿子巴兰来咒诅你们。
24.en: When Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, prepared to fight against Israel, he sent for Balaam son of Beor to put a curse on you.

24.zh: 我不肯听巴兰的话，所以他倒为你们连连祝福。这样，我便救你们脱离巴勒的手。
24.en: But I would not listen to Balaam, so he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you out of his hand.

24.zh: 你们过了约但河，到了耶利哥；耶利哥人 、 亚摩利人 、 比利洗人 、 迦南人 、 赫人 、 革迦撒人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人都与你们争战；我把他们交在你们手里。
24.en: " 'Then you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The citizens of Jericho fought against you, as did also the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites and Jebusites, but I gave them into your hands.

24.zh: 我打发黄蜂飞在你们前面，将亚摩利人的二王从你们面前撵出，并不是用你的刀，也不是用你的弓。
24.en: I sent the hornet ahead of you, which drove them out before you-also the two Amorite kings. You did not do it with your own sword and bow.

24.zh: 我赐给你们地土，非你们所修治的；我赐给你们城邑，非你们所建造的。你们就住在其中，又得吃非你们所栽种的葡萄园 、 橄榄园的果子。
24.en: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities you did not build; and you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.'

24.zh: 现在你们要敬畏耶和华，诚心实意的事奉他，将你们列祖在大河那边和在埃及所事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和华。
24.en: "Now fear the Lord and serve him with all faithfulness. Throw away the gods your forefathers worshiped beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord .

24.zh: 若是你们以事奉耶和华为不好，今日就可以选择所要事奉的：是你们列祖在大河那边所事奉的神呢？是你们所住这地的亚摩利人的神呢？至于我和我家，我们必定事奉耶和华。
24.en: But if serving the Lord seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your forefathers served beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord ."

24.zh: 百姓回答说：我们断不敢离弃耶和华去事奉别神；
24.en: Then the people answered, "Far be it from us to forsake the Lord to serve other gods!

24.zh: 因耶和华 ─ 我们的神曾将我们和我们列祖从埃及地的为奴之家领出来，在我们眼前行了那些大神迹，在我们所行的道上，所经过的诸国，都保护了我们。
24.en: It was the Lord our God himself who brought us and our fathers up out of Egypt, from that land of slavery, and performed those great signs before our eyes. He protected us on our entire journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.

24.zh: 耶和华又把住此地的亚摩利人都从我们面前赶出去。所以，我们必事奉耶和华，因为他是我们的神。
24.en: And the Lord drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites, who lived in the land. We too will serve the Lord , because he is our God."

24.zh: 约书亚对百姓说：你们不能事奉耶和华；因为他是圣洁的神，是忌邪的神，必不赦免你们的过犯罪恶。
24.en: Joshua said to the people, "You are not able to serve the Lord . He is a holy God; he is a jealous God. He will not forgive your rebellion and your sins.

24.zh: 你们若离弃耶和华去事奉外邦神，耶和华在降福之后，必转而降祸与你们，把你们灭绝。
24.en: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, he will turn and bring disaster on you and make an end of you, after he has been good to you."

24.zh: 百姓回答约书亚说：不然，我们定要事奉耶和华。
24.en: But the people said to Joshua, "No! We will serve the Lord ."

24.zh: 约书亚对百姓说：你们选定耶和华，要事奉他，你们自己作见证罢！他们说：我们愿意作见证。
24.en: Then Joshua said, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the Lord ." "Yes, we are witnesses," they replied.

24.zh: 约书亚说：你们现在要除掉你们中间的外邦神，专心归向耶和华 ─ 以色列的神。
24.en: "Now then," said Joshua, "throw away the foreign gods that are among you and yield your hearts to the Lord , the God of Israel."

24.zh: 百姓回答约书亚说：我们必事奉耶和华 ─ 我们的神，听从他的话。
24.en: And the people said to Joshua, "We will serve the Lord our God and obey him."

24.zh: 当日，约书亚就与百姓立约，在示剑为他们立定律例典章。
24.en: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he drew up for them decrees and laws.

24.zh: 约书亚将这些话都写在神的律法书上，又将一块大石头立在橡树下耶和华的圣所旁边。
24.en: And Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak near the holy place of the Lord .

24.zh: 约书亚对百姓说：看哪，这石头可以向我们作见证；因为是听见了耶和华所吩咐我们的一切话，倘或你们背弃你们的神，这石头就可以向你们作见证（倘或云云：或作所以要向你们作见证，免得你们背弃耶和华 ─ 你们的神）。
24.en: "See!" he said to all the people. "This stone will be a witness against us. It has heard all the words the Lord has said to us. It will be a witness against you if you are untrue to your God."

24.zh: 于是约书亚打发百姓各归自己的地业去了。
24.en: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

24.zh: 这些事以后，耶和华的仆人嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁，就死了。
24.en: After these things, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.

24.zh: 以色列人将他葬在他地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地的亭拿西拉，在迦实山的北边。
24.en: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

24.zh: 约书亚在世和约书亚死后，那些知道耶和华为以色列人所行诸事的长老还在的时候，以色列人事奉耶和华。
24.en: Israel served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced everything the Lord had done for Israel.

24.zh: 以色列人从埃及所带来约瑟的骸骨，葬埋在示剑，就是在雅各从前用一百块银子向示剑的父亲 、 哈抹的子孙所买的那块地里；这就作了约瑟子孙的产业。
24.en: And Joseph's bones, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the tract of land that Jacob bought for a hundred pieces of silver from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem. This became the inheritance of Joseph's descendants.

24.zh: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒也死了，就把他葬在他儿子非尼哈所得 、 以法莲山地的小山上。
